31.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
31.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
31.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

31.g: ੧ : ਗੁਣਾਂ ਅਵਗੁਣਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ
31.t: 1 : gunaa(n) avagunaa(n) dhee gatee
31.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

31.g: ਸਾਇਰ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਕਾਲਕੂਟੁ ਤੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ।
31.t: sair vichahu nikalai kaalakooT tai a(n)mirat vaanee|
31.e: Deadly poison and nectar both were churned out of the ocean.

31.g: ਉਤ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਰਿ ਮੁਕੀਐ ਉਤ ਖਾਧੈ ਹੁਇ ਅਮਰੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ।
31.t: aut khaadhai mar mukeeaai ut khaadhai hui amar paraanee|
31.e: Taking poison, one, dies whereas taking the other, (nectar) man becomes immortal.

31.g: ਵਿਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਸਪ ਦੈ ਗਰੜ ਦੁਗਾਰਿ ਅਮਿਅ ਰਸ ਜਾਣੀ।
31.t: vis vasai muh sap dhai garaR dhugaar amia ras jaanee|
31.e: Poison resides in the mouth of snake and the jewel eructed by the blue jay (the eater of snakes) is known to be life-giving nectar.

31.g: ਕਾਉ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਕੋਇਲ ਬੋਲੀ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਭਾਣੀ।
31.t: kaau na bhaavai boliaa koil bolee sabhanaa(n) bhaanee|
31.e: Crowing of the crow is disliked but the sound of nightingale is loved by all.

31.g: ਬੁਰਬੋਲਾ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵਈ ਮਿਠ ਬੋਲਾ ਜਗਿ ਮਿਤੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ।
31.t: burabolaa na sukhaaviee miTh bolaa jag mit viddaanee|
31.e: Evil speaker is not liked but the sweet tongued is praised all over the world.

31.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸੈਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਸਾਣੀ।
31.t: buraa bhalaa saisaar vich paraupakaar vikaar nisaanee|
31.e: Evil and good persons live in the same world but they are distinguished by their qualities of benevolent and perverted actions.

31.g: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਗਤਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
31.t: gun avagun gat aakh vakhaanee ||1||
31.e: We have here exposed the position of merits and demerits.

31.g: ੨ : ਖੋਜੀ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਦੀ
31.t: 2 : khojee ate vaadhee
31.e: Researcher and the disputant

31.g: ਸੁਝਹੁ ਸੁਝਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ਅੰਨ੍ਹੇ ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ।
31.t: sujhahu sujhan tin loa a(n)nhe ghughoo sujh na sujhai|
31.e: With sun's light all the three worlds are visible but the blind and the owl can not see the sun.

31.g: ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਰਤੰਤੁ ਸੁ ਬੁਝੈ।
31.t: chakavee sooraj het hai ka(n)t milai virata(n)tu su bujhai|
31.e: The female ruddy sheldrake loves the sun, and meeting the beloved they tell and listen to the love story of each other.

31.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰਾ ਪੰਖੀਆਂ ਚਕਵੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰਿ ਨ ਰੁਝੈ।
31.t: raat anheraa pa(n)kheeaa(n) chakavee chit anher na rujhai|
31.e: For all other birds the night is dark (and they sleep) but ruddy sheldrake's mind has no rest in that darkness (its mind is ever attued to sun).

31.g: ਬਿੰਬ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਰਤਾ ਜਾਣਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ਸਮੁਝੈ।
31.t: bi(n)b a(n)dhar pratibi(n)b dhekh bharataa jaan sujaan samujhai|
31.e: An intellegent woman recognises her husband even by seeing his shadow in water,

31.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਛਾਵਾ ਪਵੇ ਖੂਹਿ ਡੁਬਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੀਹੁ ਲੋਇਨ ਲੁਝੈ।
31.t: dhekh pachhaavaa pave khooh ddub marai seeh loin lujhai|
31.e: But the foolish lion, seeing its own shadow in the well jumps in it and dies and then blames its own eyes.

31.g: ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜੈ ਖੋਜੁ ਲੈ ਵਾਦੀ ਵਾਦੁ ਕਰੇਂਦੜ ਖੁਝੈ।
31.t: khojee khojai khoj lai vaadhee vaadh kare(n)dhaR khujhai|
31.e: The researcher discovers the import of the above description but the disputant is led astray

31.g: ਗੋਰਸ ਗਾਈਂ ਹਸਤਿਨ ਦੁਝੈ ॥੨॥
31.t: goras gaiee(n) hasatin dhujhai ||2||
31.e: And expects to get cow-milk from a female elephant (which in fact is impossible).

31.g: ੩ : ਬਗਲ ਸਮਾਧੀ
31.t: 3 : bagal samaadhee
31.e: Wicked persons remain unhappy even in happiness

31.g: ਸਾਵਣ ਵਣ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਵੁਠੇ ਸੁਕੈ ਅਕੁ ਜਵਾਹਾ।
31.t: saavan van hareeaavale vuThe sukai ak javaahaa|
31.e: In the month of Sayan forests go green but akk, a wild plant of sandy region, and /avail, the camel thorn, wither.

31.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀਐ ਅਪਤ ਕਰੀਰ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਉਸਾਹਾ।
31.t: chet vanasapat mauleeaai apat kareer na karai usaahaa|
31.e: In the month of Chaitr, the vegetation blooms but leafless kart (a wild caper) remains totally uninspired.

31.g: ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੰਦੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਭ ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਫਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਵਿਸਾਹਾ।
31.t: sufal fala(n)dhe birakh sabh si(n)mal afal rahai avisaahaa|
31.e: All the trees become full of fruits but the silk cotton tree remains devoid of fruit.

31.g: ਚੰਨਣ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਵਾਂਸ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ਨ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹਾ।
31.t: cha(n)nan vaas vanaasapat vaa(n)s nivaas na ubhe saahaa|
31.e: The whole vegetation is made fragrant by sandal wood but bamboo gets no impact of it and goes on sobbing and sighing.

31.g: ਸੰਖੁ ਸਮੁੰਦਹੁ ਸਖਣਾ ਦੁਖਿਆਰਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੇ ਧਾਹਾਂ।
31.t: sa(n)kh samu(n)dhahu sakhanaa dhukhiaaraa rovai dhe dhaahaa(n)|
31.e: Even being in the ocean, the conch remains empty and cries bitterly when blown.

31.g: ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਗੰਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਝੀਗੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਇ ਭਿਛਾਹਾ।
31.t: bagul samaadhee ga(n)g vich jheegai chun chun khai bhichhaahaa|
31.e: The crane even looking to be meditating upon the banks of Ganges, like a beggar picks up the fish and eats them up.

31.g: ਸਾਥ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਫਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
31.t: saath vichhu(n)ne miladhaa faahaa ||3||
31.e: Separation from good company brings noose for the individual.

31.g: ੪ : ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ
31.t: 4 : bhalaa buraa
31.e: Good and bad

31.g: ਆਪਿ ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ।
31.t: aap bhalaa sabh jag bhalaa bhalaa bhalaa sabhanaa kar dhekhai|
31.e: One's good mind finds everybody good in the world. A gentleman beholds everyone as gentle.

31.g: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰੇ ਦੇ ਲੇਖੈ।
31.t: aap buraa sabh jag buraa sabh ko buraa bure dhe lekhai|
31.e: If one is bad himself, for him the whole world is bad and all is bad on his account. Lord Krsna helped

31.g: ਕਿਸਨੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਪਾਂਡਵਾਂ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ।
31.t: kisan sahaiee paa(n)ddavaa(n) bhai bhagat karatoot visekhai|
31.e: Pindays because they had in them profuse sense of devotion and morality.

31.g: ਵੈਰ ਭਾਉ ਚਿਤਿ ਕੈਰਵਾਂ ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਲੇਖੈ।
31.t: vair bhaau chit kairavaa(n) ganatee ganan a(n)dhar kaalekhai|
31.e: Kaurays had enmity in their heart and they always calculated the dark side of things.

31.g: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਰਵੰਨਿਆ ਭਾਲਣ ਗਏ ਨ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
31.t: bhalaa buraa parava(n)niaa bhaalan ge na dhisaT sarekhai|
31.e: Two princes went out to find a good and a wicked person but their views were different.

31.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਜੁਧਿਸਟਰੈ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਭੇਖੈ।
31.t: buraa naa koiee judhisaTarai dhurajodhan ko bhalaa na bhekhai|
31.e: None was bad for Yudhisthar and Duryodhan did not find any good person.

31.g: ਕਰਵੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਟੋਟੀ ਰੇਖੈ ॥੪॥
31.t: karavai hoi su ToTee rekhai ||4||
31.e: Whatever (sweet or bitter) is there in the pot is known when it comes out through the spout.

31.g: ੫ : ਧਰਮਰਾਜ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਕਥਾ
31.t: 5 : dharamaraaj dhee prasidh kathaa
31.e: Famous tale of Dharmaraj

31.g: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਲੈ ਧਰਮ ਵੀਚਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਿਠਾ।
31.t: sooraj ghar avataar lai dharam veechaaran jai bahiThaa|
31.e: Born in the family of Sun, he (Dharrnaraj) adorned the seat of the dispenser of justice.

31.g: ਮੂਰਤਿ ਇਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਦੁਇ ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਜਮ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਰਿਠਾ।
31.t: moorat ikaa naau dhui dharamarai jam dhekh sariThaa|
31.e: He is one but the creation knows him by two names-Dharmaraj and Yama.

31.g: ਧਰਮੀ ਡਿਠਾ ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਮ ਡਿਠਾ।
31.t: dharamee ddiThaa dharamarai paap kamai paapee jam ddiThaa|
31.e: People see him pious and righteous in the form of Dharmaraj but the wicked sinner as Yama.

31.g: ਪਾਪੀ ਨੋ ਪਛੜਾਇੰਦਾ ਧਰਮੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਲੇਂਦਾ ਮਿਠਾ।
31.t: paapee no pachhaRai(n)dhaa dharamee naal bule(n)dhaa miThaa|
31.e: He also thrashes the evil doer but speks sweetly to the religious person.

31.g: ਵੈਰੀ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਵੈਰ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਇਠਾ।
31.t: vairee dhekhan vair bhai mitr bhai kar dhekhan iThaa|
31.e: Enemy sees him with enmity and the friendly people know him as loving one.

31.g: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਅਭਰਿਠਾ।
31.t: narak surag vich pu(n)n paap var saraap jaanan abhariThaa|
31.e: Sin and merit, boon and curse, heaven and hell are known and realised according to one's own feelings (of love and enmity).

31.g: ਦਰਪਣਿ ਰੂਪ ਜਿਵੇਹੀ ਪਿਠਾ ॥੫॥
31.t: dharapan roop jivehee piThaa ||5||
31.e: Mirror reflects the shadow according to the object before it.

31.g: ੬ : ਸੁੱਧ ਆਰਸੀ
31.t: 6 : su'dh aarasee
31.e: Clean mirror

31.g: ਜਿਉਂ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਆਰਸੀ ਸਭਾ ਸੁਧ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਖੈ।
31.t: jiau(n) kar niramal aarasee sabhaa sudh sabh koiee dhekhai|
31.e: In the clean mirror everybody sees his correct shape.

31.g: ਗੋਰਾ ਗੋਰੇ ਦਿਸਦਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਵੰਨੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ।
31.t: goraa gore dhisadhaa kaalaa kaale va(n)n visekhai|
31.e: Fair complexion is reflected fair and black one specifically black in it.

31.g: ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਸਤ ਮੁਖ ਰੋਂਦਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਲੇਖੈ।
31.t: has has dhekhai hasat mukh ro(n)dhaa rovanahaar sulekhai|
31.e: A laughing person finds his face laughing and weeping one as weeping in it.

31.g: ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਰਸੀ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ।
31.t: lep na lagai aarasee chhia dharasan dhisan bahu bhekhai|
31.e: The followers of six philosophies wearing different guises see in it, but the mirror remains detached to them all.

31.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਕਰੋਧ ਕੁਲੇਖੈ।
31.t: dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau hai vair virodh karodh kulekhai|
31.e: Sense of duality is the evil intellect which is the another name of enmity, opposition and anger.

31.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਸਮਦਰਸ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
31.t: gurmat niramal niramalaa samadharasee samadharas sarekhai|
31.e: Pious followers of the wisdom of Guru always remain pure and egalitarian.

31.g: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਹੁਇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੈ ॥੬॥
31.t: bhalaa buraa hui roop na rekhai ||6||
31.e: Otherwise, there is no other distinction of the good and the bad person.

31.g: ੭ : ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਹਰੂ
31.t: 7 : guroo paaharoo
31.e: Guru, the caretaker guard

31.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਰਜਿ ਆਥਵੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ ਚਮਕਨਿ ਤਾਰੇ।
31.t: eikat sooraj aathavai raat aneree chamakan taare|
31.e: Once the son sets in the evening stars twinkle in the dark night.

31.g: ਸਾਹ ਸਵਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਚੋਰ ਫਿਰਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਸਣੈਹਾਰੇ।
31.t: saeh savan ghar aapanai chor firan ghar musanaihaare|
31.e: Rich people sleep in their homes but the thieves move around to commit thefts.

31.g: ਜਾਗਨਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਹਰੂ ਰੂਆਇਨਿ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ।
31.t: jaagan virale paaharoo rooaain huseeaar bidhaare|
31.e: A few guards remain awake and go on shouting to alert others.

31.g: ਜਾਗਿ ਜਗਾਇਨਿ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਸਾਹ ਫੜੰਦੇ ਚੋਰ ਚਗਾਰੇ।
31.t: jaag jagain sutiaa saeh faRa(n)dhe chor chagaare|
31.e: Those awakened watchmen make sleeping people awake and this way they catch hold of thiefs and vagabonds.

31.g: ਜਾਗਦਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਸੁਤੇ ਘਰ ਮੁਸਨਿ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ।
31.t: jaagadhiaa ghar rakhiaa sute ghar musan vechaare|
31.e: Those who remain awake protect their homes but the house is looted of those who go on sleeping.

31.g: ਸਾਹ ਆਏ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਾਰੈ।
31.t: saeh aae ghar aapanai chor jaar lai garadhan maarai|
31.e: The rich men handing over the thieves (to the authorities), happily return home but caught from their necks the thieves are beaten hollow.

31.g: ਭਲੇ ਬੁਰੇ ਵਰਤਨਿ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
31.t: bhale bure varatan saisaare ||7||
31.e: The evil and the meritorious both are active in this world.

31.g: ੮ : ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਉ
31.t: 8 : sa(n)g subhaau
31.e: Nature of the company

31.g: ਮਉਲੇ ਅੰਬ ਬਸੰਤ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਉੜੀ ਅਕੁ ਸੁ ਫੁਲੀ ਭਰਿਆ।
31.t: maule a(n)b basa(n)t rut aauRee aku su fulee bhariaa|
31.e: In spring season, the mangoes blossom and akk the bitter wild plant of sandy region also becomes full of flowers.

31.g: ਅੰਬਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਖਖੜੀ ਅਕਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਅੰਬੁ ਅਫਰਿਆ।
31.t: a(n)b na lagai khakhaRee ak na lagai a(n)b afariaa|
31.e: The pod of akk cannot produce mango and fruitless akk cannot grow on mango tree.

31.g: ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਇਲ ਅੰਬ ਵਣਿ ਅਕਿਤਿਡੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਮਿਤਾਲਾ ਹਰਿਆ।
31.t: kaalee koil a(n)b van akitidd chit mitaalaa hariaa|
31.e: Nightingale sitting on mango tree is black and the grosshopper of akk is speckled one or green.

31.g: ਮਨ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਬਿਰਖ ਭੇਦੁ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਧਰਿਆ।
31.t: man pa(n)kheroo birakh bhedh sa(n)g subhaau soiee fal dhariaa|
31.e: Mind is a bird and due to difference of the results of different company, it gets the fruit of the tree it chooses to sit upon.

31.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਡਰਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਨ ਡਰਿਆ।
31.t: gurmat ddaradhaa saadhasa(n)g dhuramat sa(n)g asaadh na ddariaa|
31.e: Mind is scared of holy congregation and the wisdom of the Guru but is not afraid of evil company and evil intellect i.e. it does not want to go in good company and takes interest in the evil company.

31.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਿਆ।
31.t: bhagat vachhal bhee aakheeaai patit udhaaran patit udhariaa|
31.e: God is said to be loving towards saints and liberator of the fallen ones.

31.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੮॥
31.t: jo tis bhaanaa soiee tariaa ||8||
31.e: He has salvaged many fallen pepole and only he gets across who is accepted by Him.

31.g: ੯ : ਪੂਤਨਾ
31.t: 9 : pootanaa
31.e: Mani

31.g: ਜੇਕਰਿ ਉਧਰੀ ਪੂਤਨਾ ਵਿਹੁ ਪੀਆਲਣੁ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਚੰਗਾ।
31.t: jekar udharee pootanaa vih peeaalan ka(n)m na cha(n)gaa|
31.e: If even Pfitana (female demon) got liberated that does not mean that poisoning some one is a good act.

31.g: ਗਨਿਕਾ ਉਧਰੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਲਈਐ ਪੰਗਾ।
31.t: ganikaa udharee aakheeaai par ghar jai na lieeaai pa(n)gaa|
31.e: Gariika (a prostitute) was liberated but one should not enter other's house and invite trouble.

31.g: ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ਮਾਰੈ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸੰਗਾ।
31.t: baalameek nisataariaa maarai vaaT na hoi nisa(n)gaa|
31.e: Since Valmlici got blest, one should not adopt the way of highway robbery.

31.g: ਫੰਧਿਕ ਉਧਰੈ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਫੜੀਐ ਟੰਗਾ।
31.t: fa(n)dhik udharai aakheean faahee pai na faReeaai Ta(n)gaa|
31.e: One bird catcher is also said to be liberated, but we should not catch hold of the leg of others by using snares.

31.g: ਜੇ ਕਾਸਾਈ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਜੀਆ ਘਾਇ ਨ ਖਾਈਐ ਭੰਗਾ।
31.t: je kaasaiee udhariaa jeeaa ghai na khaieeaai bha(n)gaa|
31.e: If Sadhana, the butcher got across (the world ocean), we should not put ourselves to harm by killing others.

31.g: ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਲੋਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ।
31.t: paar utaarai bohithaa suinaa loh naahee ik ra(n)gaa|
31.e: Ship takes across both iron and gold but still their forms and colours are not the same.

31.g: ਇਤੁ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਕੁਢੰਗਾ ॥੯॥
31.t: eit bharavaasai rahan kudda(n)gaa ||9||
31.e: In fact, living on such hopes is a bad life style.

31.g: ੧੦ : ਪਾਪ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਬੁਰੀ ਹੈ
31.t: 10 : paap dhee rees buree hai
31.e: It is always bad to imitate evil

31.g: ਪੈ ਖਾਜੂਰੀ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਚੜੑਹਿ ਖਾਜੂਰੀ ਝੜਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ।
31.t: pai khaajooree jeeveeaai chaR(h)h khaajooree jhaRau na koiee|
31.e: Surviving the fall from the palm tree does not mean that one should climb the tree to fall from it.

31.g: ਉਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ਨ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਉਝੜ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੋਈ।
31.t: aujhaR piaa na maareeaai ujhaR raahu na cha(n)gaa hoiee|
31.e: Even if one is not killed in desolete places and ways, moving on deserted places is not safe.

31.g: ਜੇ ਸਪ ਖਾਧਾ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਪੁ ਨ ਫੜੀਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੋਈ।
31.t: je sap khaadhaa ubare sap na faReeaai a(n)t vigoiee|
31.e: One may survive even when bitten by a sanke even then catching the sanke will be harmful ultimately.

31.g: ਵਹਣਿ ਵਹੰਦਾ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਤੁਲਹੇ ਡੁਬਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਲੋਈ।
31.t: vahan vaha(n)dhaa nikalai vin tulahe ddub marai bhaloiee|
31.e: Getting washed away by the current of river if someone comes out of it alone, even then in entering the river without a raft there is more possibility of drowning.

31.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਜਾਣੋਈ।
31.t: patit udhaaran aakheeaai virateehaan jaan jaanoiee|
31.e: People of all inclinations know very well that God is liberator of the fallen ones.

31.g: ਭਾਉਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ।
31.t: bhaaubhagat gurmat hai dhuramat dharageh lahai na ddoiee|
31.e: Precept of the Guru (Gurmat) is the loving devotion and the people having evil intellect do not get shelter in the court of the Lord.

31.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਸਥੋਈ ॥੧੦॥
31.t: a(n)t kamaanaa hoi sathoiee ||10||
31.e: The deeds done in life are the only companions in the end.

31.g: ੧੧ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਾ ਫਰਕ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਰਕੇ
31.t: 11 : gurmukh manmukh dhaa farak gunaa karake
31.e: Different qualities of Gurmukh and Manmukh

31.g: ਥੋਮ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਲੋਹੁ ਨਹੀਂ ਇਕ ਵੰਨਾ।
31.t: thom kathooree vaas jiau ka(n)chan loh nahee(n) ik va(n)naa|
31.e: As the smell of the garlic and musk is different, the gold and iron are also not the same.

31.g: ਫਟਕ ਨ ਹੀਰੇ ਤੁਲਿ ਹੈ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨੜੀ ਨ ਵੜੀਐ ਗੰਨਾ।
31.t: faTak na heere tul hai samasar naRee na vaReeaai ga(n)naa|
31.e: Glass crystal is not equal to diamond and likewise, the sugarcane and a hollow reed are not the same.

31.g: ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਰਤਨਾ ਰਤਕਾ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਕਚੁ ਵਿਕਾਵੈ ਪੰਨਾ।
31.t: tul na ratanaa ratakaa mul na kach vikaavai pa(n)naa|
31.e: Red and black seed (rata) is not equal to jewel and glass cannot sell at the price of emerald.

31.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘੁੰਮਣ ਵਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਬੰਨਾਂ।
31.t: dhuramat ghu(n)man vaaneeaai gurmat sukirat bohith ba(n)naa(n)|
31.e: Evil intellect is a whirlpool but the wisdom of Guru (gurmat) is the ship of good deeds that takes across.

31.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਬੁਰੇ ਦੀ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਭਲੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ।
31.t: ni(n)dhaa hove bure dhee jai jai kaar bhale dha(n)n dha(n)naa|
31.e: Evil person is always condemned and the good person is applauded by all.

31.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਚੁ ਰਹੈ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ।
31.t: gurmukh paragaT jaaneeaai manmukh sach rahai parachha(n)naa|
31.e: Through the gurmukhs, the truth becomes manifest and thus is known by one and all, but in the manmukhs, the same truth is pressed and concealed.

31.g: ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਭੰਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
31.t: ka(n)m na aavai bhaa(n)ddaa bha(n)naa ||11||
31.e: Like a broken pot, it is of no use.

31.g: ੧੨ : ਉਹੋ ਹੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਕਰਕੇ
31.t: 12 : uho hee karanee karake
31.e: Fame and disrepute according to the actions ,

31.g: ਇਕ ਵੇਚਨਿ ਹਥੀਆਰ ਘੜਿ ਇਕ ਸਵਾਰਨਿ ਸਿਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਆ।
31.t: eik vechan hatheeaar ghaR ik savaaran silaa sa(n)joaa|
31.e: Many a man prepare arms and sell them out and many cleanse armours.

31.g: ਰਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਘਾਉ ਬਚਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਲ ਨਿਤਿ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਦੇ ਢੋਆ।
31.t: ran vich ghaau bachaau kar dhui dhal nit uTh karadhe ddoaa|
31.e: In the batle the arms inflict wounds and armours protect as the warriors of both the armies clash time and again.

31.g: ਘਾਇਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਨੰਗਾਸਣਾ ਬਖਤਰ ਵਾਲਾ ਨਵਾਂ ਨਿਰੋਆ।
31.t: ghail hoi na(n)gaasanaa bakhatar vaalaa navaa(n) niroaa|
31.e: Those uncovered are wounded but those who have worn the armour remain well and intact.

31.g: ਕਰਨਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਕਮਾਨਗਰ ਖਾਨਜਰਾਦੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਖੋਆ।
31.t: karan gumaan kamaanagar khaanajaraadhee bahut bakhoaa|
31.e: Bow makers also feel proud of their special bows.

31.g: ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਧ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਫਲੁ ਭੋਆ।
31.t: jag vich saadh asaadh sa(n)g sa(n)g subhai jai fal bhoaa|
31.e: Two types of associations, one of the sadhus and the other of the wicked ones are there in this world and meeting them different results are produced.

31.g: ਕਰਮ ਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇ ਪਰੋਆ।
31.t: karam su dharam adharam kar sukh dhukh a(n)dhar aai paroaa|
31.e: That is why, the individual because of his good and bad conduct remains absorbed in his pleasures or sufferings.

31.g: ਭਲੇ ਬੁਰੇ ਜਸੁ ਅਪਜਸੁ ਹੋਆ ॥੧੨॥
31.t: bhale bure jas apajas hoaa ||12||
31.e: The good and bad receive fame and infamy respectively.

31.t: 13 : uho hee
31.e: Fame and disrepute according to the actions

31.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥ ਸੁਗਰਥੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਆਵੈ।
31.t: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath sugarath saadhasa(n)g aavai|
31.e: Truth, contentment, compassion, dharma, wealth, and other best things are attained in the holy congregation.

31.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਮਚਾਵੈ।
31.t: kaam karodh asaadh sa(n)g lobh moh aha(n)kaar machaavai|
31.e: Association with the wicked increases lust, anger, greed, infatuation and ego.

31.g: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਹੁਇ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਵੈ।
31.t: dhukirat sukirat karam kar buraa bhalaa hui naau dharaavai|
31.e: A good or a bad name is earned on account of good or bad deeds respectively.

31.g: ਗੋਰਸੁ ਗਾਈ ਖਾਇ ਖੜੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਣਦੀ ਵਗੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ।
31.t: goras gaiee khai khaR ik ik janadhee vag vadhaavai|
31.e: Eating grass and oilcakes, the cow gives milk and giving birth to calves increases the herd.

31.g: ਦੁਧਿ ਪੀਤੈ ਵਿਹੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਪ ਜਣਿ ਜਣਿ ਬਹਲੇ ਬਚੇ ਖਾਵੈ।
31.t: dhudh peetai vih dhei sap jan jan bahale bache khaavai|
31.e: Drinking milk, the snake vomits poison and eats up its Own progeny.

31.g: ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ।
31.t: sa(n)g subhaau asaadh saadh paap pu(n)n dhukh sukh fal paavai|
31.e: The association with the sadhus and wickeds variously produces sin and meirit, sorrows and pleasures.

31.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧੩॥
31.t: paraupakaar vikaar kamaavai ||13||
31.e: The fill, inculcates benevolence or evil propensities.

31.g: ੧੪ : ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ
31.t: 14 : bhalaa buraa
31.e: Good and bad one

31.g: ਚੰਨਣੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਦੇ ਚੰਨਣੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਬਾਏ।
31.t: cha(n)nan birakh subaas dhe cha(n)nan karadhaa birakh sabaae|
31.e: Giving fragrance to all trees, the sandalwood tree makes them fragrant.

31.g: ਖਹਦੇ ਵਾਂਸਹੁਂ ਅਗਿ ਧੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਲੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਜਲਾਏ।
31.t: khahadhe vaa(n)sahu(n) ag dhukh aap jalai paravaar jalaae|
31.e: By the friction of the bamboos (on the other hand) the bamboo itself gets burnt and burns the whole family (of bamboos).

31.g: ਮੁਲਹ ਜਿਵੈ ਪੰਖੇਰੂਆ ਫਾਸੈ ਆਪਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਫਹਾਏ।
31.t: muleh jivai pa(n)kherooaa faasai aap kuTa(n)b fahaae|
31.e: Twithering quail not only gets caught but also makes the whole family ensnared.

31.g: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੁਇ ਪਰਬਤਹੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਏ।
31.t: asaT dhaat hui parabatahu paaras kar ka(n)chan dhikhalaae|
31.e: The eight metals found in the mountains are converted into gold by the philosopher's stone.

31.g: ਗਣਿਕਾ ਵਾੜੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ।
31.t: ganikaa vaaRai jai kai hovan rogee paap kamaae|
31.e: The people going to the prostitutes earn sins besides contagious diseases.

31.g: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਆਵਨਿ ਵੈਦ ਘਰ ਦਾਰੂ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਏ।
31.t: dhukhe'ee aavan vaidh ghar dhaaroo dhe dhe rog miTaae|
31.e: The sufferers from a disease come to the physician and he giving medicine cures them.

31.g: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਦੁਇ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੧੪॥
31.t: bhalaa buraa dhui sa(n)g subhaae ||14||
31.e: Because of the nature of the company kept, one becomes good or bad.

31.g: ੧੫ : ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ
31.t: 15 : bhalaa buraa
31.e: Good and bad

31.g: ਭਲਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਦਾ ਸਹੈ ਅਵਟਣੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਏ।
31.t: bhalaa subhaau majeeTh dhaa sahai avaTan ra(n)g chaRhaae|
31.e: The nature of madder is gentle; it bears the heat but dyes others in fast colour.

31.g: ਗੰਨਾ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਟਟਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਮਿਠਾਸੁ ਵਧਾਏ।
31.t: ga(n)naa koloo peeReeaai TaTar piaa miThaas vadhaae|
31.e: Sugarcane is first crushed in crusher and then put on fire in a cauldron where it further increases its sweetness when baking soda is put into it.

31.g: ਤੁੰਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਜੀਐ ਕਉੜਤਣ ਦੀ ਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ।
31.t: tu(n)me a(n)mrit si(n)jeeaai kauRatan dhee baan na jaae|
31.e: Colocynth even if irrigated with nectar, does not shed its bitterness.

31.g: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਏ।
31.t: avagun keete gun karai bhalaa na avagun chit vasaae|
31.e: A noble person does not adopt demerits in his heart and does good to the evil doer.

31.g: ਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਤੇ ਅਉਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਮੰਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਏ।
31.t: gun keete aaugun karai buraa na ma(n)n a(n)dhar gun paae|
31.e: But the evil doer does not adopt virutues in his heart, and does evil to the benevolent.

31.g: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
31.t: jo beejai soiee fal khaae ||15||
31.e: One reaps what one sows.

31.g: ੧੬ : ਭਲੇ ਬੁਰੇ ਦੀ ਸੁਭਾਵਕ ਨੇਕੀ ਬਦੀ
31.t: 16 : bhale bure dhee subhaavak nekee badhee
31.e: Natural evil or goodness of the bad and the noble

31.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਥਰ ਲੀਕ ਜਿਉ ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ।
31.t: paanee pathar leek jiau bhalaa buraa parakirat subhaae|
31.e: As is the case with water and stone, things are good or bad according to their nature.

31.g: ਵੈਰੁ ਨ ਟਿਕਦਾ ਭਲੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਬੁਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ।
31.t: vair na Tikadhaa bhale chit het na Tikai burai man aae|
31.e: A noble heart carries no enmity, and love does not abide in an evil heart.

31.g: ਭਲਾ ਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਦਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਵੈਰੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਰਾਏ।
31.t: bhalaa na het visaaradhaa buraa na vair manahu visaraae|
31.e: The noble one never forgets good done to him whereas the evil doer does not forget enmity.

31.g: ਆਸ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਦੁਹਾ ਦੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਖਾਏ।
31.t: aas na pujai dhuhaa dhee dhuramat gurmat a(n)t lakhaae|
31.e: Both fmd in the end their desires unfulfilled because the evil still wants to commit evil and the noble wants to go on spreading benevolence.

31.g: ਭਲਿਅਹੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਹੀ ਬੁਰਿਅਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਏ।
31.t: bhaliahu buraa na hovahee buriahu bhalaa na bhalaa manaae|
31.e: The noble cannot commit evil but the noble should not expect nobility in an evil person.

31.g: ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ਸਈ ਸਿਆਣੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
31.t: virateehaan vakhaaniaa siee siaanee sikh sunaae|
31.e: This is the essence of the wisdom of hundreds of people and accordingly I have explained the thoughts in vogue around.

31.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਏ ॥੧੬॥
31.t: paraupakaar vikaar kamaae ||16||
31.e: Benevolence may (at times) be repaid in the form of evil.

31.g: ੧੭ : ਭਲੇ ਬੁਰੇ ਦੀ ਕਹਾਣੀ
31.t: 17 : bhale bure dhee kahaanee
31.e: The tale of the noble and bad one)

31.g: ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ਭਲੇ ਬੁਰੇ ਦੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਾਣੀ।
31.t: virateehaan vakhaaniaa bhale bure dhee sunee kahaanee|
31.e: On the basis of the stories listened to, I have described the present state of affairs.

31.g: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਦੁਇ ਚਲੇ ਰਾਹਿ ਉਸ ਥੈ ਤੋਸਾ ਉਸ ਥੈ ਪਾਣੀ।
31.t: bhalaa buraa dhui chale raeh us thai tosaa us thai paanee|
31.e: A bad and a noble man went on a journey. The noble one had bread and the evil had water with him.

31.g: ਤੋਸਾ ਅਗੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਭਲੇ ਭਲਾਈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਣੀ।
31.t: tosaa agai rakhiaa bhale bhalaiee a(n)dhar aanee|
31.e: Being noble-natured, the good person laid out bread to eat.

31.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਹਥੀਂ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਦਿਤੋ ਪਾਣੀ।
31.t: buraa buraiee kar giaa hathee(n) kadd na dhito paanee|
31.e: The evil minded performed his wickedness (and ate up his bread) tut did not offer water to him.

31.g: ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾਈਅਹੁ ਸਿਝਿਆ ਬੁਰੇ ਬੁਰਾਈਅਹੁੰ ਵੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
31.t: bhalaa bhalaieeahu sijhiaa bure buraieeahu(n) vain vihaanee|
31.e: The noble got the fruit of his nobility (and got liberated) but the evil person had to spend this night of life, weeping and wailing.

31.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਜੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ਜਾਣੀ।
31.t: sachaa saahib niaau sach jeeaa(n) dhaa jaanoiee jaanee|
31.e: That omnicient Lord is true and His justice is also true.

31.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧੭॥
31.t: kudharat kaadhar no kurabaanee ||17||
31.e: I am sacrifice unto the creator and His creation (because different are the natutes of the two children of the same Lord).

31.g: ੧੮ : ਰਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਵਣ
31.t: 18 : raam ate raavan
31.e: Ram and Ravan

31.g: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਸੈਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ।
31.t: bhalaa buraa saisaar vich jo aaiaa tis sarapar maranaa|
31.e: The evil and noble exist in this world and whosoever came here, has to die one day.

31.g: ਰਾਵਣ ਤੈ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਵਾਂਗਿ ਮਹਾਂ ਬਲੀ ਲੜਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ।
31.t: raavan tai raamacha(n)dh vaa(n)g mahaa(n) balee laR kaaran karanaa|
31.e: The brave persons like Ravan and Ram also became the cause and doers of wars.

31.g: ਜਰੁ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਅਧਰਮ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਮਨ ਧਰਣਾ।
31.t: jar jaravaanaa vas kar a(n)t adharam raavan man dharanaa|
31.e: Controlling the mighty age, i.e. conquering the time, Ravan adopted evil in his heart (and stole Sita).

31.g: ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਰਮਹੁ ਸਾਇਰ ਪਥਰ ਤਰਣਾ।
31.t: raamacha(n)dh niramal purakh dharamahu sair pathar taranaa|
31.e: Ram was a spotless person and due to his sense of dharma (responsibility), even the stones floated in ocean.

31.g: ਬੁਰਿਆਈਅਹੁ ਰਾਵਣੁ ਗਇਆ ਕਾਲਕ ਟਿਕਾ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਹਰਣਾ।
31.t: buriaaieeahu raavan giaa kaalak Tikaa par tria haranaa|
31.e: On account of wickedness Ravan went away (was killed) with the stigma of stealing another's wife.

31.g: ਰਾਮਾਇਣੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਅਟਲੁ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਏ ਸਰਣਾ।
31.t: raamain jug jug aTal se udhare jo aae saranaa|
31.e: Ramayan (the story of Ram) is ever firm (in the mind of people) and whosoever seeks shelter (in it) goes across (the world ocean).

31.g: ਜਸ ਅਪਜਸ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਡਰ ਡਰਣਾ ॥੧੮॥
31.t: jas apajas vich niddar ddaranaa ||18||
31.e: Dharma-abiding people earn glory in the world and those who undertake evil adventures get infamy.

31.g: ੧੯ : ਰਾਵਣ ਦੀ ਜਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਿੱਧ ਕਥਾ
31.t: 19 : raavan dhee jagat prasi'dh kathaa
31.e: Famous tale of Ram and Ravan

31.g: ਸੋਇਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਵਡਾ ਗੜੁ ਖਾਰ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਜਿਵੇਹੀ ਖਾਈ।
31.t: soin la(n)kaa vaddaa gaR khaar samu(n)dh jivehee khaiee|
31.e: Golden Lanka was a grand fort and the ocean around it was like a vast moat.

31.g: ਲਖ ਪੁਤੁ ਪੋਤੇ ਸਵਾ ਲਖੁ ਕੁੰਭਕਰਣੁ ਮਹਿਰਾਵਣੁ ਭਾਈ।
31.t: lakh put pote savaa lakh ku(n)bhakaran mahiraavan bhaiee|
31.e: Ravan had one lac sons, one and a quarter lac grand sons and brothers like Kumbhkaran and Mahiravari.

31.g: ਪਵਣੁ ਬੁਹਾਰੀ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਤਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਭਰੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਰੑਹਿਆਈ।
31.t: pavan buhaaree dhei nit i(n)dhr bharai paanee var(h)hiaaiee|
31.e: Air would broom his palaces whereas Indr through rains carried water for him.

31.g: ਬੈਸੰਤੁਰ ਰਾਸੋਈਆ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਚਰਾਗ ਦੀਪਾਈ।
31.t: baisa(n)tur raasoieeaa sooraj cha(n)dh charaag dheepaiee|
31.e: Fire was his cook and the sun and the moon his lamp burners.

31.g: ਬਹੁ ਖੂਹਣਿ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਦਲ ਦੇਸ ਨ ਵੇਸ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
31.t: bahu khoohan chatura(n)g dhal dhes na ves na keemat paiee|
31.e: His huge army of horses, elephants, chariots and infantry comprising many khuhants (akeauhauts, one aksauhani is known as a mixed force of 21870 elephants, 21870 chariots, 65610 horse and 109350 foot soldiers) was such whose power and grandeur cannot be e

31.g: ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਰਹਦੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
31.t: mahaadhev dhee sev kar dhev dhaanav rahadhe saranaiee|
31.e: He (Ravan) had served Mahadev (Siva) and due to this all the gods and demons were under his shelter.

31.g: ਅਪਜਸੁ ਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
31.t: apajas lai dhuramat buriaaiee ||19||
31.e: But evil intellect and actions earned him infamy.

31.g: ੨੦ : ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਦੀ ਲੋਕ ਪ੍ਰਸਿੱਧ ਕਥਾ
31.t: 20 : raamacha(n)dh dhee lok prasi'dh kathaa
31.e: Famous story of Ramchandr

31.g: ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਆ ਦੇਹਿਧਾਰੀ।
31.t: raamacha(n)dh kaaran karan kaaran vas hoaa dhehidhaaree|
31.e: Due to some reason, Lord, the cause of all the causes assumed the form of Ramchandr.

31.g: ਮੰਨਿ ਮਤੇਈ ਆਗਿਆ ਲੈ ਵਣਵਾਸੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਚਾਰੀ।
31.t: ma(n)n mateiee aagiaa lai vanavaas vaddaiee chaaree|
31.e: Accepting the orders of his step mother he went in exile and earned greatness.

31.g: ਪਰਸਰਾਮੁ ਦਾ ਬਲੁ ਹਰੈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਗਰਬ ਪਰਹਾਰੀ।
31.t: parasaraam dhaa bal harai dheen dhiaal garab parahaaree|
31.e: Compassionate for the poor and decimator of the proud ones Ram effaced the power and pride of Pars'u Ram.

31.g: ਸੀਤਾ ਲਖਮਣ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ।
31.t: seetaa lakhaman sev kar jatee satee sevaa hitakaaree|
31.e: Serving Warn, Laksaman became yati, the subduer of all passions and Sits also with all the virtues of a sati, remained totally devoted to Ram and served him.

31.g: ਰਾਮਾਇਣੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ।
31.t: raamain varataiaa raam raaj kar sirasaT udhaaree|
31.e: Ramayan spread far and wide as the story establishing Ram-Rajy, a virtuous kingdom.

31.g: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ।
31.t: maran munasaa sach hai saadhasa(n)gat mil paij savaaree|
31.e: Ram had liberated the whole world. Death for them is a truth who, having come to the holy congregation, have fulfilled their commitment to life.

31.g: ਭਲਿਆਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥੩੧॥
31.t: bhaliaaiee satigur mat saaree ||20||31||
31.e: Benevolence is the perfect teaching of the Guru.

32.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
32.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
32.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

32.g: ੧ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਲੱਛਣ
32.t: 1 : gurmukh la'chhan
32.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

32.g: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੈ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ।
32.t: pahilaa gurmukh janam lai bhai vich varatai hoi iaanaa|
32.e: Having been born in this world, the gurmukh becoming innocent and ignorant ducts himself in the fear of the Lord.

32.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ।
32.t: gur sikh lai gursikh hoi bhai bhagat vich kharaa siaanaa|
32.e: Adopting the teaching of the Guru becomes the Sikh of the Guru and sustaining himself in the loving devotion, e leads a pure and intelligent life.

32.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨੈ ਸਮਝਿ ਮਾਣ ਮਹਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ।
32.t: gursikh sun ma(n)nai samajh maan mahat vich rahai nimaanaa|
32.e: After listening to and understanding it, e accepts the teachings of the Guru and even earning the glories continues be humble.

32.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਪੂਜਦਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਰਹਿਰਾਸ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ।
32.t: gur sikh gursikh poojadhaa pairee pai rahiraas lubhaanaa|
32.e: In accordance with the teachings of the Guru, he worships the e Sikhs and touching their feet and, following their virtus path, he becomes avourite of all.

32.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ।
32.t: gur sikh manahu na visarai chalan jaan jugat mihamaanaa|
32.e: Guru's instruction is never forgotten by the Sikh and he having learnt the way of considering himself as a passing guest, spends his life (purposefully) here.

32.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
32.t: gursikh miThaa bolanaa niv chalanaa gursikh paravaanaa|
32.e: The Sikh of the Guru speaks sweetly and accept  humility as the proper way of life.

32.g: ਘਾਲਿ ਖਾਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਲਿ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
32.t: ghaal khai gursikh mil khaanaa ||1||
32.e: The Gurmukh, guru-oriented person earns is livelihood by hard labour and shares his victuals with other Sikhs of the um.

32.g: ੨ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ-ਤਾਣ ਨਿਤਾਣਾ
32.t: 2 : gurmukha-taan nitaanaa
32.e: Gurmukh strong yet humble-

32.g: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਵਧਾਨੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਚੇਤੰਨੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ।
32.t: dhisaT dharas liv saavadhaan sabadh surat cheta(n)n siaanaa|
32.e: The vision of a gurmukh remains seated in his desire for the glimpse of the Lord, and by virtue of his watchful realization of the sabad, he acquires wisdom.

32.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜੁ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਣਾ।
32.t: naam dhaan isanaan dhiR man bach karam karai melaanaa|
32.e: Being steadfast in meditation upon mint, charity, and ablution, he maintains co-ordination in his mind, speech and actions.

32.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਥੋੜਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਥੋੜਾ ਸਉਣਾ ਥੋੜਾ ਖਾਣਾ।
32.t: gursikh thoRaa bolanaa thoRaa saunaa thoRaa khaanaa|
32.e: The Sikh of the Guru speaks less, sleeps less and eats little.

32.g: ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਮਾਣਾ।
32.t: par tan par dhan paraharai par ni(n)dhaa sun man saramaanaa|
32.e: Repudiating other's body (woman) and other's wealth he avoids listening to the slander of others.

32.g: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
32.t: gur moorat gur sabadh hai saadhasa(n)gat samasar paravaanaa|
32.e: He accepts the presence of Guru equally in the sabad (Word) and the holy congregation.

32.g: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ।
32.t: eik man ik araadhanaa dhuteeaa naasat bhaavai bhaanaa|
32.e: With single-mindedness he adores the one Lord, and having no sense of duality, he rejoices in the will of the Lord.

32.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਤਾਣ ਨਿਤਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
32.t: gurmukh hodhai taan nitaanaa ||2||
32.e: Despite his all powers the gurmukh considers himself meek and humble .

32.g: ੩ : ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਤੋਂ ਵਿਰਵਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਹੀਣਾ ਤੇ ਇਕੱਲਾ ਹੈ
32.t: 3 : manmukh gurmukh to(n) viravaa manmukh moorakh heenaa te ika'laa hai
32.e: The self-willed one is a fool, deprived and alone,   ,

32.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਅਖੀਂ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਸੋਈ।
32.t: gurmukh ra(n)g na dhisiee ho(n)dhee akhee(n) a(n)nhaa soiee|
32.e: He who cannot see the grandneur of gurmukhs is blind despite his eyes.

32.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਕੰਨੀਂ ਬੋਲਾ ਹੋਈ।
32.t: gurmukh samajh na sakiee ho(n)dhee ka(n)nee(n) bolaa hoiee|
32.e: He ‘who does not understand the idea of a gurmukh is deaf despite his ears.

32.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਈ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਜੀਭੈ ਗੁੰਗਾ ਗੋਈ।
32.t: gurmukh sabadh na gaaviee ho(n)dhee jeebhai gu(n)gaa goiee|
32.e: He ho does not sing the hymns of Gurmukh is dumb though having a tongue.

32.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਦੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਕਟਾ ਹੋਂਦੇ ਨਕਿ ਅਲੋਈ।
32.t: charan kaval dhee vaas vin nakaTaa ho(n)dhe nak aloiee|
32.e: Devoid of the fragrance of the lotus feet of the Guru, he is supposed to be with a clipped nose (brazen-faced) despite his lovely nose.

32.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਕਰੀ ਲੁੰਜਾ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਈ।
32.t: gurmukh kaar vihooniaa ho(n)dhee karee lu(n)jaa dhukh roiee|
32.e: A person devoid of Gurmukh's sense of service is a wailing cripple, his healthy hands notwithstanding and he goes on weeping.

32.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਸਈ ਸੋ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨ ਲਹਂਦਾ ਢੋਈ।
32.t: gurmat chit na vasiee so mat heen na laha(n)dhaa ddoiee|
32.e: One in whose heart, the wisdom of the Guru is not sustained, is a fool who gets no shelter anywhere.

32.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਸਥੋਈ ॥੩॥
32.t: moorakh naal na koi sathoiee ||3||
32.e: The idiot has no companion.

32.g: ੪ : ਮੂਰਖ ਘੁੱਘੂ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
32.t: 4 : moorakh ghu'ghoo dhirashaTaa(n)t
32.e: Fool compared to owl,

32.g: ਘੁੱਘੂ ਸੁਝ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਵਸਦੀ ਛਡਿ ਰਹੈ ਓਜਾੜੀ।
32.t: ghu'ghoo sujh na sujhiee vasadhee chhadd rahai ojaaRee|
32.e: Owl does not have any thoughtful understanding and leaving habitats lives in deserted places.

32.g: ਇਲਿ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਨਾ ਪੜ੍ਹੈ ਚੂਹੇ ਖਾਇ ਉਡੇ ਦੇਹਾੜੀ।
32.t: eil paRhaiee naa paRhai choohe khai udde dhehaaRee|
32.e: Kite cannot be taught texts and eating rats keeps on flying the whole day.

32.g: ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਂਸ ਨੋ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਿ ਨ ਚੰਦਣ ਵਾੜੀ।
32.t: vaas na aavai vaa(n)s no haumai ag na cha(n)dhan vaaRee|
32.e: Even being in the garden of sandal wood, the egotist bamboo does not get fragrant.

32.g: ਸੰਖ ਸਮੁੰਦਹੁ ਸਖਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੀਣਾ ਦੇਹ ਵਿਗਾੜੀ।
32.t: sa(n)kh samu(n)dhahu sakhanaa gurmat heenaa dheh vigaaRee|
32.e: As the conch remains empty though liviing in sea, the person devoid of the wisdom of Guru (gurmati) is spoiling his body.

32.g: ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਪ ਗਣਾਏ ਵਡਾ ਅਨਾੜੀ।
32.t: si(n)mal birakh na safal hoi aap ganaae vaddaa anaaRee|
32.e: The cotton-silk tree does not bear fruit howsoever much that colourless may brag of its greatness.

32.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਫਕੜਿ ਪਵੈ ਰਿਹਾੜੀ ॥੪॥
32.t: moorakh fakaR pavai rihaaRee ||4||
32.e: Only fools quarrls over trivialities.

32.g: ੫ : ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਨ੍ਹੇ ਦੀ ਆਰਸੀ
32.t: 5 : moorakh a(n)nhe dhee aarasee
32.e: Mirror before a blind fool

32.g: ਅੰਨ੍ਹੇ ਅਗੇ ਆਰਸੀ ਨਾਈ ਧਰਿ ਨ ਵਧਾਈ ਪਾਵੈ।
32.t: a(n)nhe age aarasee naiee dhar na vadhaiee paavai|
32.e: A barber showing mirror to a blind person never gets the reward.

32.g: ਬੋਲੇ ਅਗੇ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਸੂੰਮ ਨ ਡੂਮ ਕਵਾਇ ਪੈਨ੍ਹਾਵੈ।
32.t: bole age gaaveeaai soo(n)m na ddoom kavai painhaavai|
32.e: Singing before a deaf person is in vain and likewise a miser does not present a robe to his minstrel as a gift.

32.g: ਪੁਛੈ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਗੁੰਗਿਅਹੁ ਵਿਗੜੈ ਕੰਮੁ ਜਵਾਬੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ।
32.t: puchhai masalat gu(n)giahu vigaRai ka(n)m javaab na aavai|
32.e: If the dumb is consulted on any issue, the issue will go worse and he will not be able to answer.

32.g: ਫੁਲਵਾੜੀ ਵੜਿ ਗੁਣਗੁਣਾ ਮਾਲੀ ਨੋ ਨ ਇਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ।
32.t: fulavaaRee vaR gunagunaa maalee no na inaam dhivaavai|
32.e: If a person devoid of the sense of smell goes to a garden, he cannot recommend the gardener for award.

32.g: ਲੂਲੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਆਹੀਐ ਕਿਵ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ।
32.t: loole naal viaaheeaai kiv gal mil kaaman gal laavai|
32.e: How could a woman married to a cripple embrace him.

32.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਲੰਗੜਾ ਕਰੇ ਲਖਾਉ ਲੰਗਾਵੈ।
32.t: sabhanaa chaal suhaavanee la(n)gaRaa kare lakhaau la(n)gaavai|
32.e: Where all others have a fair gait, the lame however he may pretend, would definitely be seen limping.

32.g: ਲੁਕੈ ਨ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
32.t: lukai na moorakh aap lakhaavai ||5||
32.e: Thus, the fool never remains hidden, and he definitely exposes himself.

32.g: ੬ : ਮੂਰਖ ਦਾ ਸੌਰਨਾ
32.t: 6 : moorakh dhaa sauaranaa
32.e: Reclamation of a fool

32.g: ਪਥਰੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਸਉ ਵਰੑਹਿਆਂ ਜਲਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸੈ।
32.t: pathar mool na bhijiee sau var(h)hiaa(n) jal a(n)dhar vasai|
32.e: Even after remaining in water for a hundred years the stone would not get wet at all.

32.g: ਪਥਰ ਖੇਤ ਨ ਜੰਮਈ ਚਾਰਿ ਮਹੀਨੇ ਇੰਦਰ ਵਰਸੈ।
32.t: pathar khet na ja(n)miee chaar maheene i(n)dhar varasai|
32.e: It may rain for four months continuously, but a stone would not sprout in the field.

32.g: ਪਥਰਿ ਚੰਨਣੁ ਰਗੜੀਏ ਚੰਨਣ ਵਾਂਗਿ ਨ ਪਥਰੁ ਘਸੈ।
32.t: pathar cha(n)nan ragaRe'e cha(n)nan vaa(n)g na pathar ghasai|
32.e: A stone grinding sandal, never gets worn off like sandal.

32.g: ਸਿਲ ਵਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਪੀਸਦੇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਜਾਣੈ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਰਸੈ।
32.t: sil vaTe nit peesadhe ras kas jaanai vaas na rasai|
32.e: Grinding stones always grind the material but never know about the taste and virtues of the things ground.

32.g: ਚਕੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਹੰਸਵਾਰ ਖਾਇ ਨ ਪੀਐ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਤਸੈ।
32.t: chakee firai saha(n)savaar khai na peeaai bhukh na tasai|
32.e: The grinding stone moves around thousands of times but it never feels hunger or thirst.

32.g: ਪਥਰ ਘੜੈ ਵਰਤਣਾ ਹੇਠਿ ਉਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਘੜਾ ਵਿਣਸੈ।
32.t: pathar ghaRai varatanaa heTh ute hoi ghaRaa vinasai|
32.e: The relationship between the stone and the pitcher is such that pitcher has to perish whether the stone strikes the pitcher or vice versa.

32.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਸ ਅਪਜਸੈ ॥੬॥
32.t: moorakh surat na jas apajasai ||6||
32.e: The stupid does not understand the difference between fame and infamy.

32.g: ੭ : ਮੂਰਖ ਪੱਥਰ ਹੈ ਸੰਗ ਵਿਚ ਕੁਸੰਗੀ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ
32.t: 7 : moorakh pa'thar hai sa(n)g vich kusa(n)gee rahi(n)dhaa hai
32.e: The fool is a stone; he remains adamant in any company

32.g: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਥਰ ਸੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਨ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ।
32.t: paaras pathar sa(n)g hai paaras paras na ka(n)chan hovai|
32.e: Ordinary stone may be in contact with the philosopher's stone but it does not get transformed into gold.

32.g: ਹੀਰੇ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਥਰਹੁ ਪਥਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ।
32.t: heere maanak patharahu pathar koi na haar parovai|
32.e: Diamonds and rubies are extracted from the stones but the latter cannot be stringed as a necklace.

32.g: ਵਟਿ ਜਵਾਹਰੁ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਵਿਕਾਇ ਸਮੋਵੈ।
32.t: vaT javaahar toleeaai mul na tul vikai samovai|
32.e: The jewels are weighed with weights but the latter cannot equate in value with the jewels.

32.g: ਪਥਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਸੁਵੰਨ ਅਲੋਵੈ।
32.t: pathar a(n)dhar asaTadhaat paaras paras suva(n)n alovai|
32.e: Eight metals (alloys) remain amidst stones but they convert into gold by the touch of philosopher's stone alone.

32.g: ਪਥਰੁ ਫਟਕ ਝਲਕਣਾ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਗੋਵੈ।
32.t: pathar faTak jhalakanaa bahu ra(n)gee hoi ra(n)g na govai|
32.e: Crystal stone shines in many colours but still remains a mere stone.

32.g: ਪਥਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਸਾਉ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਕਠੋਰ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ।
32.t: pathar vaas na saau hai man kaThor hoi aap vigovai|
32.e: Stone has neither fragrance nor taste; the hard-hearted one simply destroys itself.

32.g: ਕਰਿ ਮੂਰਖਾਈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੭॥
32.t: kar moorakhaiee moorakh rovai ||7||
32.e: The foolish goes on lamenting his own stupidity.

32.g: ੮ : ਮੂਰਖ ਦਾ ਸੰਗ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ
32.t: 8 : moorakh dhaa sa(n)g naa karo
32.e: Do not keep company with a foolish one

32.g: ਜਿਉਂ ਮਣਿ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਪ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਵਿਸੂ ਭਰਿਆ।
32.t: jiau(n) man kaale sap sir saar na jaanai visoo bhariaa|
32.e: Having jewel in its head and knowing it not, the snake remains filled with poison.

32.g: ਜਾਣੁ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗ ਤਨਿ ਝਾੜਾਂ ਸਿੰਙਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਫਰਿਆ।
32.t: jaan kathooree mirag tan jhaaRaa(n) si(n)n(g)dhaa firai afariaa|
32.e: It is known that musk remains in the body of deer, but it goes on smelling it franatically in the bushes.

32.g: ਜਿਉਂ ਕਰਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਸਿਪ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ।
32.t: jiau(n) kar motee sip vich maram na jaanai a(n)dhar dhariaa|
32.e: The pearl dwells in the shell but the shell does not know the mystery.

32.g: ਜਿਉਂ ਗਾਈ ਥਣਿ ਚਿਚੁੜੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਨ ਪੀਐ ਲੋਹੂ ਜਰਿਆ।
32.t: jiau(n) gaiee than chichuRee dhudh na peeaai lohoo jariaa|
32.e: The tick stuck with the teats of cow, takes not its milk but sucks the blood only.

32.g: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਤਰਣਿ ਨ ਸਿਖਿਓ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਨ ਪਥਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ।
32.t: bagulaa taran na sikhio teerath nai na pathar tariaa|
32.e: Living in water the crane never learns how to swim and the stone, in spite of its ablutions at various pilgrimage centres cannot swim and go across.

32.g: ਨਾਲਿ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਭਲੀ ਭਿਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਰਾਜਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਸਰਿਆ।
32.t: naal siaane bhalee bhikh moorakh raajahu kaaj na sariaa|
32.e: That is why, begging in the company of wise people is better then ruling over a kingdom alongwith Hoots.

32.g: ਮੇਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗਾੜੈ ਖਰਿਆ ॥੮॥
32.t: mekhee hoi vigaaRai khariaa ||8||
32.e: Because he who himself is fake, will also spoil the pure one.

32.g: ੯ : ਮੂਰਖ ਨਾਲ ਓਪਰੇ ਰਹੋ
32.t: 9 : moorakh naal opare raho
32.e: Be indifferent to the company of fools

32.g: ਕਟਣੁ ਚਟਣੁ ਕੁਤਿਆਂ ਕੁਤੈ ਹਲਕ ਤੈ ਮਨੁ ਸੂਗਾਵੈ।
32.t: kaTan chaTan kutiaa(n) kutai halak tai man soogaavai|
32.e: The dog, only bites and licks but if it goes mad, one's mind becomes scared of it.

32.g: ਠੰਢਾ ਤਤਾ ਕੋਇਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥ ਜਲਾਵੈ।
32.t: Tha(n)ddaa tataa koilaa kaalaa kar kai hath jalaavai|
32.e: Coal whether cold or hot makes the hand black or burns it.

32.g: ਜਿਉ ਚਕਚੂੰਧਰ ਸਪ ਦੀ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਕੋੜ੍ਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਵੈ।
32.t: jiau chakachoo(n)dhar sap dhee a(n)nhaa koRhee kar dhikhalaavai|
32.e: Mole caught by snake makes it blind or leper.

32.g: ਜਾਣੁ ਰਸਉਲੀ ਦੇਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਢੀ ਪੀੜ ਰਖੀ ਸਰਮਾਵੈ।
32.t: jaan rasaulee dheh vich vaddee peeR rakhee saramaavai|
32.e: Tumor in the body when operated upon gives pain and if it is kept untouched it is a cause for embarrassment.

32.g: ਵੰਸਿ ਕਪੂਤੁ ਕੁਲਛਣਾ ਛਡਿਆ ਬਣੈ ਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
32.t: va(n)s kapoot kulachhanaa chhaddiaa banai na vich samaavai|
32.e: A wicked son can neither be repudiated nor he can adjust in the family.

32.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਵਲਾਵੈ।
32.t: moorakh het na laieeaai parahar vair alipat valaavai|
32.e: Therefore, the stupid should not be loved and while enmity towards him should be avoided, detachment towards him should be maintained.

32.g: ਦੁਹੀਂ ਪਵਾੜੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥੯॥
32.t: dhuhee(n) pavaaRee dhukh vihaavai ||9||
32.e: Otherwise, both the ways, suffering is bound to occur.

32.g: ੧੦ : ਮੂਰਖ ਬੇਥਵਾ ਤੇ ਔਗੁਣ ਗ੍ਰਾਹੀ ਹੈ
32.t: 10 : moorakh bethavaa te aauagun graahee hai
32.e: The fool is absurd and chooses evils

32.g: ਜਿਉ ਹਾਥੀ ਦਾ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਣਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਖੇਹ ਉਡਾਵੈ।
32.t: jiau haathee dhaa nhaavanaa baahar nikal kheh uddaavai|
32.e: As the elephant washes its body and coming out of water, it throws mud over it;

32.g: ਜਿਉ ਊਠੈ ਦਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਣਕ ਜਵਾਹਾ ਖਾਵੈ।
32.t: jiau uooThai dhaa khaavanaa parahar kanak javaahaa khaavai|
32.e: As the camel avoiding wheat eats low variety of corn named java-s;

32.g: ਕਮਲੇ ਦਾ ਕਛੋਟੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਲਕ ਕਦੇ ਸੀਸਿ ਵਲਾਵੈ।
32.t: kamale dhaa kachhoTaRaa kadhe lak kadhe sees valaavai|
32.e: The loin cloth of mad man is sometimes worn by him around his waiste and sometimes on his head;

32.g: ਜਿਉਂ ਕਰਿ ਟੁੰਡੇ ਹਥੜਾ ਸੋ ਚੁਤੀਂ ਸੋ ਵਾਤਿ ਵਤਾਵੈ।
32.t: jiau(n) kar Tu(n)dde hathaRaa so chutee(n) so vaat vataavai|
32.e: The hand of a cripple sometime goes to his buttocks and the same one sometimes to his mouth when yawning;

32.g: ਸੰਨ੍ਹੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਲੁਹਾਰ ਦੀ ਖਿਣੁ ਜਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਿਨ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
32.t: sa(n)nhee jaan luhaar dhee khin jal vich khin agan samaavai|
32.e: Blacksmith's pincers are sometimes put in fire and the next moment in water;

32.g: ਮਖੀ ਬਾਣੁ ਕੁਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਲੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ।
32.t: makhee baan kubaan hai lai dhuraga(n)dh suga(n)dh na bhaavai|
32.e: Evil is the nature of fly, it prefers foul smell to fragrance;

32.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਦਾ ਕਿਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧੦॥
32.t: moorakh dhaa kih hath na aavai ||10||
32.e: Likewise, the fool gets nothing.

32.g: ੧੧ : ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੇ ਫਸਦੇ ਤੇ ਕੁਫੱਕੜੀ ਹਨ
32.t: 11 : moorakh aape fasadhe te kufa'kaRee han
32.e: Foolish gets himself entrapped and is a liar

32.g: ਤੋਤਾ ਨਲੀ ਨ ਛਡਈ ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀਂ ਫਾਥਾ ਚੀਕੈ।
32.t: totaa nalee na chhaddiee aapan hathee(n) faathaa cheekai|
32.e: The parrot does not leave the rod and caught in it cries and wails.

32.g: ਬਾਂਦਰੁ ਮੁਠਿ ਨ ਛਡਈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਚੈ ਝੀਕਣੁ ਝੀਕੈ।
32.t: baa(n)dhar muTh na chhaddiee ghar ghar nachai jheekan jheekai|
32.e: Monkey too does not leave the handful of corn (in the pitcher) and suffers dancing and gritting its teeth from door to door.

32.g: ਗਦਹੁ ਅੜੀ ਨ ਛਡਈ ਚੀਘੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਹੀਕਣਿ ਹੀਕੈ।
32.t: gadhahu aRee na chhaddiee cheeghee paudhee heekan heekai|
32.e: The donkey also when beaten, kicks and brays loudly but does not shed its stubbornness.

32.g: ਕੁਤੇ ਚਕੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਸਿਧੀ ਧ੍ਰੀਕਣਿ ਧ੍ਰੀਕੈ।
32.t: kute chakee chaTanee poochh na sidhee dhreekan dhreekai|
32.e: The dog does not leave licking the flour mill and its tail though pulled, never turns straight.

32.g: ਕਰਨਿ ਕੁਫਕੜ ਮੂਰਖਾਂ ਸਪ ਗਏ ਫੜਿ ਫਾਟਨਿ ਲੀਕੈ।
32.t: karan kufakaR moorakhaa(n) sap ge faR faaTan leekai|
32.e: The foolish ones boast foolishly and beat the track while the snake has gone away.

32.g: ਪਗ ਲਹਾਇ ਗਣਾਇ ਸਰੀਕੈ ॥੧੧॥
32.t: pag lahai ganai sareekai ||11||
32.e: Even when humiliated by their turbans taken off their heads, they count themselves superior to their collaterals.

32.g: ੧੨ : ਮੂਰਖ ਸੱਚ ਦਾ ਯਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ
32.t: 12 : moorakh sa'ch dhaa yaar nahee(n)
32.e: Stupid is not friendly to truth

32.g: ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਆਖੇ ਲੜਿ ਮਰੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ।
32.t: a(n)nhaa aakhe laR marai khusee hovai sun naau sujaakhaa|
32.e: The blind stupid one fights to the finish if he is called blind (intellectually) and feels flattered if called eyed (a wise one).

32.g: ਭੋਲਾ ਆਖੇ ਭਲਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਅਹਮਕੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਅਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਭਾਖਾ।
32.t: bholaa aakhe bhalaa ma(n)n ahamak jaan ajaan na bhaakhaa|
32.e: Calling him simple minded makes him feel good but he would not talk to one who tells him that he is a silly person.

32.g: ਧੋਰੀ ਆਖੈ ਹਸਿ ਦੇ ਬਲਦ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਕਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਖਾ।
32.t: dhoree aakhai has dhe baladh vakhaan karai man maakhaa|
32.e: He smiles at being called a carrier of the burden (of all) but feels angry when told that he is just an ox.

32.g: ਕਾਉਂ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਨ ਭਾਖ ਸੁਭਾਖਾ।
32.t: kaau(n) siaanap jaanadhaa visaTaa khai na bhaakh subhaakhaa|
32.e: The crow knows many skills but it crows jarringly and eats faeces.

32.g: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਰੀਤ ਕੁਰੀਤ ਦਾ ਮੁਸਕ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਗਾਂਡੀ ਸਾਖਾ।
32.t: naau sureet kureet dhaa musak bilaiee gaa(n)ddee saakhaa|
32.e: To the bad customs the stupid refers as good conduct and calls the indurated faeces of cat, fragrant.

32.g: ਹੇਠਿ ਖੜਾ ਥੂ ਥੂ ਕਰੈ ਗਿਦੜ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਦਾਖਾ।
32.t: heTh khaRaa thoo thoo karai gidhaR hath na aavai dhaakhaa|
32.e: As the jackal unable to reach and eat grapes on tree, spits over them, so is the case of a fool.

32.g: ਬੋਲਵਿਗਾੜੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਭੇਡਾਖਾ ॥੧੨॥
32.t: bolavigaaR moorakh bheddaakhaa ||12||
32.e: The foolish person is a blind follower like sheep and his obdurate talk spoils his relationship with every one.

32.g: ੧੩ : ਮੂਰਖ ਵਿਣ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰਬੀ ਹੈ
32.t: 13 : moorakh vin gun gurbee hai
32.e: Devoid of virtues, the stupid is arrogant

32.g: ਰੁਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਰੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਅਰੰਡੁ ਅਞਾਈ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ।
32.t: rukhaa(n) vich kurukh hai ara(n)dd an(j)aiee aap ganaae|
32.e: The worst possible among the trees is castor tree which undesrvedly makes itself noticed.

32.g: ਪਿਦਾ ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੇਰੂਆਂ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਡਾਲੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਫਾਏ।
32.t: pidhaa jiau pa(n)kherooaa(n) beh beh ddaalee bahut bafaae|
32.e: Pidd jiu, a very small among the birds goes an jumping from one branch to another and feels much inflated.

32.g: ਭੇਡ ਭਿਵਿੰਗਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਰਣਾਪੈ ਦਿਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਲਾਏ।
32.t: bhedd bhivi(n)gaa muh karai taranaapai dheh chaar valaae|
32.e: The sheep, too, during its brief... youth bleats loudly (proudly).

32.g: ਮੁਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਨਕੁ ਕਨ ਜਿਉਂ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀਆਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਾਂਡਿ ਸਦਾਏ।
32.t: muh akhee nak kan jiau(n) i(n)dhreeaa(n) vich gaa(n)dd sadhaae|
32.e: Anus also feels proud of being called one of the organs like eye, ear, nose and mouth.

32.g: ਮੀਆ ਘਰਹੁ ਨਿਕਾਲੀਐ ਤਰਕਸੁ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਟੰਗਵਾਏ।
32.t: meeaa gharahu nikaaleeaai tarakas dharavaaje Ta(n)gavaae|
32.e: The husband even while kicked out of home by wife hangs his quiver at the door (to show his masculinity).

32.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਾਣਸਾਂ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੈ ਆਲਾਏ।
32.t: moorakh a(n)dhar maanasaa(n) vin gun garab karai aalaae|
32.e: Similarly among the human beings, the stupid one devoid of all virtues feels proud of himself and persistently tries to get noticed.

32.g: ਮਜਲਸ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥੧੩॥
32.t: majalas baiThaa aap lakhaae ||13||
32.e: In an assembly, he beholds only his ownself (and not the wisdom of others).

32.g: ੧੪ : ਮੂਰਖ ਕੌਣ ਹੈ ?
32.t: 14 : moorakh kauan hai ?
32.e: Who is a fool?   ?

32.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਬੋਲੁ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
32.t: moorakh tis no aakheeaai bol na samajhai bol na jaanai|
32.e: Foolish is he who neither understands the matter in hand nor speaks well.

32.g: ਹੋਰੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਹੋਰੋ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
32.t: horo kih kar puchheeaai horo kiau kar aakh vakhaanai|
32.e: He is asked something else and he replies altogether about something different.

32.g: ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਅਰਥੁ ਅਨਰਥੁ ਮਨੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਣੈ।
32.t: sikh dhei samajhaieeaai arath anarath manai vich aanai|
32.e: Ill advised, he misinterprets it and brings forth from his mind the contrary meaning.

32.g: ਵਡਾ ਅਸਮਝੁ ਨ ਸਮਝਈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
32.t: vaddaa asamajh na samajhiee surat vihoonaa hoi hairaanai|
32.e: He is a big idiot who does not understand and being devoid of consciousness is ever surprised and confused.

32.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
32.t: gurmat chit na aaviee dhuramat mitr satr paravaanai|
32.e: He never cherishes in his heart the wisdom of the Gum and due to his evil intellect considers his friend as a foe.

32.g: ਅਗਨੀ ਸਪਹੁਂ ਵਰਜੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਰੈ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
32.t: aganee sapahu(n) varajeeaai gun vich avagun karai dhin(g)aanai|
32.e: The wisdom of not going near snake and fire he takes otherwise and forcibly turns virtue into vice.

32.g: ਮੂਤੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਮਾਂ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥੧੪॥
32.t: moote rovai maa(n) na sin(j)aanai ||14||
32.e: He behaves like an infant who does not recognise his mother and goes on crying and pissing.

32.g: ੧੫ : ਮੂਰਖ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ
32.t: 15 : moorakh dhee pachhaan
32.e: Identification of a fool

32.g: ਰਾਹੁ ਛਡਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਵੈ ਆਗੂ ਨੋ ਭੁਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ।
32.t: raahu chhadd ujhaR pavai aagoo no bhulaa kar jaanai|
32.e: He who leaving the path away follows a trackless waste and considers his leader gone astray, is a fool.

32.g: ਬੇੜੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਐ ਕੁਦਿ ਪਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਹਣ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
32.t: beRe vich bahaaleeaai kudh pavai vich vahan dhin(g)aanai|
32.e: Seated in the boat he jumps impulsively into the current.

32.g: ਸੁਘੜਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਿਠਿਆਂ ਬੋਲਿਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਉਘਾੜਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
32.t: sughaRaa(n) vich bahiThiaa(n) bolivigaaR ughaaR vakhaanai|
32.e: Sitting among the noble ones he, due to his ill talk stands exposed.

32.g: ਸੁਘੜਾਂ ਮੂਰਖ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੈ।
32.t: sughaRaa(n) moorakh jaanadhaa aap sughaR hoi virateehaanai|
32.e: The wise he considers stupid and hids his own conduct as a clever one.

32.g: ਦਿਹ ਨੋ ਰਾਤਿ ਵਖਾਣਦਾ ਚਾਮਚੜਿਕ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਟਾਨਾਣੈ।
32.t: dheh no raat vakhaanadhaa chaamachaRik jive(n) Taanaanai|
32.e: Like , a bat and a glow worm he describes the day as night.

32.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਣੈ ॥੧੫॥
32.t: gurmat moorakh chit na aanai ||15||
32.e: The wisdom of Gum never resides in the heart of a foolish person.

32.g: ੧੬ : ਮੂਰਖ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ
32.t: 16 : moorakh dhaa a(n)t
32.e: The end of a fool

32.g: ਵੈਦਿ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ਉਠਣੀ ਲੈ ਸਿਲ ਵਟਾ ਕਚਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ।
32.t: vaidh cha(n)geree uThanee lai sil vaTaa kacharaa bha(n)naa|
32.e: A physician in order to cure a female camel, of a melon stuck in its throat, crushed the melon in its throat by hitting out side the neck with his pestle and mortar.

32.g: ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸਿਖੀ ਵੈਦਗੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਬੁਢੀ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਰੰਨਾ।
32.t: sevak sikhee vaidhagee maaree buddee rovan ra(n)naa|
32.e: His servant (who was watching) thought he had mastered the art and killed an old ill woman by the same process, causing general lamentation among women.

32.g: ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਵਲੈ ਪਉਦੀ ਉਘੜਿ ਗਏ ਸੁ ਕੰਨਾ।
32.t: pakaR chalaiaa raavalai paudhee ughaR ge su ka(n)naa|
32.e: The people seized the pretending physician and produced him before the king who ordered for him a thorough beating, upon which he came to his senses.

32.g: ਪੁਛੈ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਉਨੁ ਉਘੜਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਾਜੁ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ।
32.t: puchhai aakh vakhaaniaun ughaR giaa paaj parachha(n)naa|
32.e: When questioned he confessed the whole circumstance and his imposture was thus exposed.

32.g: ਪਾਰਖੂਆ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਕਚਕੜਾ ਨ ਰਲੈ ਰਤੰਨਾ।
32.t: paarakhooaa chun kaddiaa jiau kachakaRaa na ralai rata(n)naa|
32.e: The wise men threw him out as a piece of glass cannot rank with jewels.

32.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਵਾਂਸਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਗੰਨਾ।
32.t: moorakh akalee baaharaa vaa(n)sahu mool na hovee ga(n)naa|
32.e: A fool has no sense as a bamboo could never equal sugar-cane.

32.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਸੂ ਉਪੰਨਾ ॥੧੬॥
32.t: maanas dhehee pasoo upa(n)naa ||16||
32.e: He in fact, is an animal born in the form of a man.

32.g: ੧੭ : ਮੂਰਖ ਰੀਸ ਦਾ ਫਲ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਹੈ
32.t: 17 : moorakh rees dhaa fal bhogadhaa hai
32.e: The foolish undergoes the results of imitation

32.g: ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਹੈ ਦੇ ਪੁਤੈ।
32.t: mahaadhev dhee sev kar var paiaa saahai dhe putai|
32.e: The son of a banker served Mahadev and got a boon (of attaining wealth).

32.g: ਦਰਬੁ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਰੇਵੜੈ ਆਇ ਵੜੇ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਤੈ।
32.t: dharab saroop sarevaRai aai vaRe ghar a(n)dhar utai|
32.e: Wealth came to his house in the guise of sadhus of gramanic tradition.

32.g: ਜਿਉ ਹਥਿਆਰੀ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਦਰਬ ਹੋਹਿ ਧੜ ਧੁਤੈ।
32.t: jiau hathiaaree maareean tiau tiau dharab hoh dhaR dhutai|
32.e: As they were beaten, heaps of money emerged there in his house.

32.g: ਬੁਤੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਡਿਠਿਓਨੁ ਨਾਈ ਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੁਤੈ।
32.t: butee karadhe ddiThion naiee chain na baiThe sutai|
32.e: A barber working in the house also saw this scene and he becoming restive lost his sleep.

32.g: ਮਾਰੇ ਆਣਿ ਸਰੇਵੜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਮਸਾਣਿ ਅਛੁਤੈ।
32.t: maare aan sarevaRe sun dheebaan masaan achhutai|
32.e: Availing an opportunity he killed all the sadhus and the matter of the innocent victims came to the court of law.

32.g: ਮਥੈ ਵਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਆ ਵਾਲ ਛਡਾਇਨ ਕਿਸ ਦੈ ਬੁਤੈ।
32.t: mathai vaal pachhaaRiaa vaal chhaddain kis dhai butai|
32.e: Catching hold from his hair he was thrashed. Now by what power he will give rescued from that clutch.

32.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਬੀਉ ਕੁਰਤੈ ॥੧੭॥
32.t: moorakh beejai beeau kuratai ||17||
32.e: The foolish sows seeds out of season (and suffers loss).

32.g: ੧੮ : ਪੰਡਤ ਵੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ
32.t: 18 : pa(n)ddat vee moorakh ho sakadhaa hai
32.e: Even a pandit could be a fool

32.g: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਾਂਗੇ ਤੇਲੀਐ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖੈ।
32.t: gosaT gaa(n)ge teleeaai pa(n)ddit naal hovai jag dhekhai|
32.e: A discussion between Gangu, the oilman and a pandit was being witnessed by one and all.

32.g: ਖੜੀ ਕਰੈ ਇਕ ਅੰਗੁਲੀ ਗਾਂਗਾ ਦੁਇ ਵੇਖਾਲੈ ਰੇਖੈ।
32.t: khaRee karai ik a(n)gulee gaa(n)gaa dhui vekhaalai rekhai|
32.e: Showing one finger to Gang/ the pandit indicated that the Lord is one. But Gangu thought that he wanted to extract his (Ganges) one eye and hence he showed two fingers indicating that he will bring out both of his (pandit's) eyes.

32.g: ਫੇਰਿ ਉਚਾਇ ਪੰਜਾਂਗੁਲਾ ਗਾਂਗਾ ਮੁਠਿ ਹਲਾਇ ਅਲੇਖੈ।
32.t: fer uchai pa(n)jaa(n)gulaa gaa(n)gaa muTh halai alekhai|
32.e: But the pandit thought that Gangu is hinting at the two dimensions of Lord - nirgun (beyond all virtues) and sagun, (with all virtues).

32.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਾਰਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਭੇਖੈ।
32.t: pairee pai uTh chaliaa pa(n)ddit haar bhulaavai bhekhai|
32.e: Pandit now raised five fingers to show that His two forms are due to the five elements, but, considering the pandit as indicating that with five fingers he would scratch the face of Gangu,

32.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਅੰਗ ਦੁਇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪੰਜਿ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
32.t: niragun saragun a(n)g dhui paramesar pa(n)j milan sarekhai|
32.e: Gangs brandished his fist showing that he would kill him by the stroke of his fist. Now pandit felt that he was being made to understand that unity of five elements was the cause of the creation.

32.g: ਅਖੀ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਭੰਨਸਾਂ ਮੁਕੀ ਲਾਇ ਹਲਾਇ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ।
32.t: akhee dhove(n) bha(n)nasaa(n) mukee lai halai nimekhai|
32.e: Mistakingly the pandit accepted his defeat and fell at his opponent's feet and left the place. In fact the fool had meant that he would bring out his eyes and attack with a tight fist but this was interpreted differently by the pandit.

32.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ ॥੧੮॥
32.t: moorakh pa(n)ddit surat visekhai ||18||
32.e: Thus because of his specific thinking even the pandit was also proved a fool.

32.g: ੧੯ : ਮੂਰਖ ਦੀ ਸੰਗਤ ਦਾ ਫਲ
32.t: 19 : moorakh dhee sa(n)gat dhaa fal
32.e: The result of association with the stupid one

32.g: ਠੰਢੇ ਖੂਹਹੁੰ ਨ੍ਹਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਗ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਨੰਗੈ।
32.t: Tha(n)dde khoohahu(n) nhai kai pag visaar aaiaa sir na(n)gai|
32.e: Having taken bath on the well, a person forgot his turban and returned home bare headed.

32.g: ਘਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੰਨਾ ਕਮਲੀਆਂ ਧੁਸੀ ਲੀਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਢੰਗੈ।
32.t: ghar vich ra(n)naa kamaleeaa(n) dhusee leetee dhekh kudda(n)gai|
32.e: Seeing his improper conduct (of being bare headed) the silly women started weeping and wailing (Seeing turbanless master of the house they conjectured the death of some one in the family).

32.g: ਰੰਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਟੰਦੀਆ ਢਾਹਾਂ ਮਾਰੈਂ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸੰਗੈ।
32.t: ra(n)naa dhekh piTa(n)dheeaa ddaahaa(n) maarai(n) hoi nisa(n)gai|
32.e: Seeing the weeping women, others too, began mourning. People gethered and sitting in lines started condoling with the family.

32.g: ਲੋਕ ਸਿਆਪੇ ਆਇਆ ਰੰਨਾ ਪੁਰਸ ਜੁੜੇ ਲੈ ਪੰਗੈ।
32.t: lok siaape aaiaa ra(n)naa puras juRe lai pa(n)gai|
32.e: Now the barber woman who leads the mourning on occasions asked as to who is to be wept and whose dirge she should lead, i.e. what is the name of the dead.

32.g: ਨਾਇਣ ਪੁਛਦੀ ਪਿਟਦੀਆਂ ਕਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ਅਲ੍ਹਾਣੀ ਅੰਗੈ।
32.t: nain puchhadhee piTadheeaa(n) kis dhai nai alhaanee a(n)gai|
32.e: The daughter-in-law of family hinted towards father-in-law to elicit answer of this question (because he was found bare headed.

32.g: ਸਹੁਰੇ ਪੁਛਹ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਉਣ ਮੁਆ ਨੂਹ ਉਤਰੁ ਮੰਗੈ।
32.t: sahure puchheh jai kai kaun muaa nooh utar ma(n)gai|
32.e: Then the fact was disclosed by him that he just forgot to wear turban).

32.g: ਕਾਵਾਂ ਰੌਲਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸੰਗੈ ॥੧੯॥
32.t: kaavaa(n) raualaa moorakh sa(n)gai ||19||
32.e: In the assembly of the fools such cawing takes place (because crows also listening to one voice start cawing jointly).

32.g: ੨੦ : ਮੂਰਖ ਨਾਲ ਕਿੱਕੁਰ ਵਰਤੀਏ
32.t: 20 : moorakh naal ki'kur varate'ee
32.e: How to deal with a fool

32.g: ਜੇ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਛਾਵ ਨ ਧੁਪਾ।
32.t: je moorakh samajhaieeaai samajhai naahee chhaav na dhupaa|
32.e: Even if told about the shade and the sunshine, the fool does not understand it.

32.g: ਅਖੀਂ ਪਰਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਪਿਤਲ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਕੈਹਾਂ ਰੁਪਾ।
32.t: akhee(n) parakh na jaaniee pital suinaa kaihaa(n) rupaa|
32.e: With his eyes he cannot distinguish between brass and bronze or gold and silver.

32.g: ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਲ ਘਿਅ ਧਰਿਆ ਕੋਲਿ ਘੜੋਲਾ ਕੁਪਾ।
32.t: saau na jaanai tel ghia dhariaa kol ghaRolaa kupaa|
32.e: He can not know the difference of taste between the pot of ghee and an oil vessel.

32.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤੁਲਿ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰਾ ਘੁਪਾ।
32.t: surat vihoonaa raat dhih chaanan tul anheraa ghupaa|
32.e: Day and night he is devoid of consciousness and to him light and darkness are the same.

32.g: ਵਾਸੁ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਥੋਮ ਦੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਕੁਲੀ ਅਧਉੜੀ ਤੁਪਾ।
32.t: vaas kathooree thom dhee mihar kulee adhauRee tupaa|
32.e: Fragrance of musk and odour of garlic or stiching of velvet and hide are the same for him.

32.g: ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸਮਝਈ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਕੁਰੰਗੁ ਅਛੁਪਾ।
32.t: vairee mitr na samajhiee ra(n)g sura(n)g kura(n)g achhupaa|
32.e: He does not identify a friend and an enemy and remains completely unconcerned towards the bad or good colour (of life).

32.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਨਾਲਿ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ਚੁਪਾ ॥੨੦॥੩੨॥
32.t: moorakh naal cha(n)geree chupaa ||20||32||
32.e: Silence is the best in the company of fool.

33.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
33.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
33.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

33.g: ੧ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਨਮੁਖ
33.t: 1 : gurmukh manmukh
33.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

33.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਅਸਾਧ ਜਗਤ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
33.t: gurmukh manmukh jaaneean saadh asaadh jagat varataaraa|
33.e: From their conduct in the world, the Guru-oriented, gurmukhs and mind oriented manmukhs are known sadhus and wicked ones respectively.

33.g: ਦੁਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਬਾਜਰੇ ਖਰਬੜ ਹੋਏ ਖੁਦੀ ਖੁਆਰਾ।
33.t: dhuh vich dhukhee dhubaajare kharabaR hoe khudhee khuaaraa|
33.e: Out of these two, the mongrels-apparently sadhus but internally thieves--are always in wavering state and, suffering for their ego, go astray.

33.g: ਦੁਹੀਂ ਸਰਾਈਂ ਜਰਦਰੂ ਦਗੇ ਦੁਰਾਹੇ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਗਾਰਾ।
33.t: dhuhee(n) saraiee(n) jaradharoo dhage dhuraahe chor chugaaraa|
33.e: Such double-faced thieves, backbiters and cheats remain pale-faced due to their bewilderment in both the worlds.

33.g: ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ।
33.t: naa uravaar na paar hai gote khaan bharam sir bhaaraa|
33.e: They are neither here nor there and, burdened with the load of delusions go on drowing in between and getting suffocated.

33.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ।
33.t: hi(n)dhoo musalamaan vich gurmukh manmukh vich gubaaraa|
33.e: Whether Muslim or the Hindu, the manmukh among the gurmukhs is the utter darkness.

33.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
33.t: ja(n)man maran sadhaa sir maaraa ||1||
33.e: His head is always loaded with the comings and goings through transmigration of his soul.

33.g: ੨ : ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ
33.t: 2 : hi(n)dhoo musalamaan
33.e: Hindu-Muslim

33.g: ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਦੁਇ ਜਣੇ ਦੁਹੁ ਜਣਿਆਂ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ।
33.t: dhuh mil ja(n)me dhui jane dhuh janiaa(n) dhui raeh chalaae|
33.e: Consequent to the confluence of male and female both (Hindu and Muslim) were born; but both initiated separate ways (sects).

33.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਆਖਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਏ।
33.t: hi(n)dhoo aakhan raam raam musalamaanaa(n) naau khudhaae|
33.e: Hindus remember Ram-Ram and the Muslims named Him Khuda.

33.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਸਉਹਿਆਂ ਪਛਮਿ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣ ਨਿਵਾਏ।
33.t: hi(n)dhoo poorab sauhiaa(n) pachham musalamaan nivaae|
33.e: Hindus perform their worship facing East and Muslims bow towards the West.

33.g: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸਿ ਹਿੰਦੂਆਂ ਮਕਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਮਨਾਏ।
33.t: ga(n)g banaaras hi(n)dhooaa(n) makaa musalamaan manaae|
33.e: Hindus adore Ganges and Banaras, whereas Muslims celebrate Mecca.

33.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਮਜਹਬ ਚਲਾਏ।
33.t: vedh katebaa chaar chaar chaar varan chaar majahab chalaae|
33.e: They have four scriptures each--four Vedas and four Katebas. Hindus created four varnas (castes) and Muslims the four sects (Hanifis, Safis, Malikis, and Hambalis).

33.g: ਪੰਜ ਤਤ ਦੋਵੈ ਜਣੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਛਾਏ।
33.t: pa(n)j tat dhovai jane paun paanee baisa(n)tar chhaae|
33.e: But in fact, the same air, water and fire exist in them all.

33.g: ਇਕ ਥਾਉਂ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਉਂ ਧਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
33.t: eik thaau(n) dhui naau(n) dharaae ||2||
33.e: The ultimate shelter for both is the same one; only they have given different names to it.

33.g: ੩ : ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਆਰਸੀ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
33.t: 3 : dhubaajaraa aarasee dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
33.e: Example of double-talker and the double-faced mirror,

33.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਭਿਤੀ ਆਰਸੀ ਮਜਲਸ ਹਥੋ ਹਥੀ ਨਚੈ।
33.t: dhekh dhubhitee aarasee majalas hatho hathee nachai|
33.e: Double-faced i.e. uneven minor moves hand to hand in the assembly (because nobody likes it).

33.g: ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਪਰਾਈ ਖਚੈ।
33.t: dhukho dhukh dhubaajaree ghar ghar firai paraiee khachai|
33.e: Similarly a double-talker like a prostitute engrossed in other's homes moves from door to door.

33.g: ਅਗੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਚਹਮਚੈ।
33.t: ago hoi suhaavanee muh ddiThai maanas chahamachai|
33.e: At first she looks pretty and men are pleased to see her face

33.g: ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ ਇਕੋ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਜਿਨਸਿ ਵਿਰਚੈ।
33.t: pichhahu dhekh ddaraavanee iko muh dhuh jinas virachai|
33.e: But later she is found to be dreadful because her single face possesses two images.

33.g: ਖੇਹਿ ਪਾਇ ਮੁਹੁ ਮਾਂਜੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਕਚੈ।
33.t: kheh pai muh maa(n)jeeaai fir fir mail bharai ra(n)g kachai|
33.e: Even cleaned with ashes, such double-faced mirror becomes filthy again.

33.g: ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਜਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਹੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਭਰਮ ਪਰਚੈ।
33.t: dharamarai jam ik hai dharam adharam na bharam parachai|
33.e: Yama, the Lord of dharma is one; he accepts dharma but does not get pleased by the delusions of wickedness.

33.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ॥੩॥
33.t: gurmukh jai milai sach sachai ||3||
33.e: Truthful gurmukhs ultimately attain the truth.

33.g: ੪ : ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਮੈਤ੍ਰੀ ਕਰਾਉਣਾ ਏਸ ਦਾ ਕੰਮ ਹੈ
33.t: 4 : gur sikh paradhaan hai te maitree karaaunaa es dhaa ka(n)m hai
33.e: Sikh of the Guru is superior

33.g: ਵੁਣੈ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ਤੰਦੁ ਗੰਢਿ ਇਕੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਣਾ ਵਾਣਾ।
33.t: vunai julaahaa ta(n)dh ga(n)dd ik soot kar taanaa vaanaa|
33.e: By tying the threads, weaver weaves huge warp and weft with a single yarn.

33.g: ਦਰਜੀ ਪਾੜਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਦਾ ਪਾਟਾ ਮੁਲ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਵਿਕਾਣਾ।
33.t: dharajee paaR vigaaRadhaa paaTaa mul na lahai vikaanaa|
33.e: Tailor tears and spoils cloth and torn cloth cannot be sold.

33.g: ਕਤਰਣਿ ਕਤਰੈ ਕਤਰਣੀ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਮੂਹੀ ਚੜ੍ਹਦੀ ਸਾਣਾ।
33.t: kataran katarai kataranee hoi dhumoohee chaRhadhee saanaa|
33.e: His double-blade honed scissors cuts the cloth.

33.g: ਸੂਈ ਸੀਵੈ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆਂ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਣਾ।
33.t: sooiee seevai joR kai vichhuRiaa(n) kar mel milaanaa|
33.e: On the other hand, his needle stiches and the separated pieces are thus reunited.

33.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਇਕੋ ਰਾਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾ।
33.t: saahib iko raeh dhui jag vich hi(n)dhoo musalamaanaa|
33.e: That Lord is one but different ways have been created by Hindus and Muslims.

33.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦੀ ਹੈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
33.t: gursikhee paradhaan hai peer mureedhee hai paravaanaa|
33.e: The path of Sikhism is superior to both because it accepts an intimate relation between the Guru and the Sikh.

33.g: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਿਆਂ ਹੈਰਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
33.t: dhukhee dhubaajariaa(n) hairaanaa ||4||
33.e: The double-minded are always perplexed and thus they suffer.

33.g: ੫ : ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ-ਚਰਖਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
33.t: 5 : dhubaajaraa-charakhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
33.e: The-double-talker compared with the spinningwheel-

33.g: ਜਿਉ ਚਰਖਾ ਅਠਖੰਭੀਆ ਦੁਹਿ ਲਠੀ ਦੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੰਝੇਰੂ।
33.t: jiau charakhaa aThakha(n)bheeaa dhuh laThee dhe ma(n)jh ma(n)jheroo|
33.e: The eight board spinningwheel moves between two upright posts.

33.g: ਦੁਇ ਸਿਰ ਧਰਿ ਦੁਹੁ ਖੁੰਢ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਰ ਗਿਰਦਾਨ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਖਫੇਰੂ।
33.t: dhui sir dhar dhuh khu(n)dd vich sir giradhaan firai lakhaferoo|
33.e: Both ends of its axle are thrust in the holes in the middle of two post and on the force of its neck the wheel is turned innumerable times.

33.g: ਬਾਇੜੁ ਪਾਇ ਪਲੇਟੀਐ ਮਾਲ੍ਹ ਵਟਾਇ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਟ ਘੇਰੂ।
33.t: baiR pai paleTeeaai maalh vaTai paiaa ghaT gheroo|
33.e: The two sides are secured by a fastening cord and a string belt encircles the wheel and the spindle.

33.g: ਦੁਹੁ ਚਰਮਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਤ੍ਰਕਲਾ ਕਤਨਿ ਕੁੜੀਆਂ ਚਿੜੀਆਂ ਹੇਰੂ।
33.t: dhuh charamakh vich trakalaa katan kuReeaa(n) chiReeaa(n) heroo|
33.e: Two pieces of leather hold the spindle around which the girls spin sitting in groups.

33.g: ਤ੍ਰਿੰਞਣਿ ਬਹਿ ਉਠ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਉਡਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ।
33.t: tira(n)n(j)n beh uTh jaa(n)dheeaa(n) jiau birakhahu udd jaan pa(n)kheroo|
33.e: Sometimes they would suddenly stop spinning and leave as birds fly from the tree (the double-minded person is also like these girls or birds and changes his mind abruptly).

33.g: ਓੜਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੂ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਕਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ਗੇਰੂ।
33.t: oR nibaahoo naa theeaai kachaa ra(n)g ra(n)gaiaa geroo|
33.e: Ochre colour which is temporary one, does not give company up to the last i.e. it fades away after sometime.

33.g: ਘੁੰਮਿ ਘੁਮੰਦੀ ਛਾਉ ਘੁਵੇਰੂ ॥੫॥
33.t: ghu(n)m ghuma(n)dhee chhaau ghuveroo ||5||
33.e: The double-minded person (also) is like a moving shadow which does not stick to one place

33.g: ੬ : ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਦੂਈ ਵਿਭਚਾਰਣ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ
33.t: 6 : dhubaajaraa dhooiee vibhachaaran isatree
33.e: The fickle-minded and the adulteress woman

33.g: ਸਾਹੁਰੁ ਪੀਹਰੁ ਪਲਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਲਜ ਨ ਲਜਾ ਧੋਵੈ।
33.t: saahur peehar palarai hoi nilaj na lajaa dhovai|
33.e: Abandoning both the families of father and father-in-laws, the shameless woman cares not for modesty and does not wish to wash away her immoral reputation.

33.g: ਰਾਵੈ ਜਾਰੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾਣਿ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ।
33.t: raavai jaar bhataar taj khi(n)jotaan khusee kiau hovai|
33.e: Deserting her husband, if she enjoys the company of her paramour, how can she, moving in different lustful directions, be happy?

33.g: ਸਮਝਾਈ ਨਾ ਸਮਝਹੀ ਮਰਣੇ ਪਰਣੇ ਲੋਕੁ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ।
33.t: samajhaiee naa samajhahee marane parane lok vigovai|
33.e: No advice prevails upon her and she is despised at all social gatherings of mourning and rejoicing.

33.g: ਧਿਰਿ ਧਿਰਿ ਮਿਲਦੇ ਮੇਹਣੇ ਹੁਇ ਸਰਮਿੰਦੀ ਅੰਝੂ ਰੋਵੈ।
33.t: dhir dhir miladhe mehane hui sarami(n)dhee a(n)jhoo rovai|
33.e: She weeps in contrition because she is disdaifully reproached at every door.

33.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਹਾਣਿ ਕਾਣਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਖੜੋਵੈ।
33.t: paap kamaane pakaReeaai haan kaan dheebaan khaRovai|
33.e: For her sins, she is arrested and punished by the court where she loses every iota of honour that she had.

33.g: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਘਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜੋਵੈ।
33.t: marai na jeevai dhukh sahai rahai na ghar vich par ghar jovai|
33.e: She is miserable because now she is neither dead nor alive; she still looks for another house to ruin because she does not like to live in her own home.

33.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥੬॥
33.t: dhubidhaa avagun haar parovai ||6||
33.e: Similarly doubt or double-mindedness weaves for it the garland of vices.

33.g: ੭ : ਦੁਐਤ ਤੇ ਸਿੱਖ
33.t: 7 : dhuaait te si'kh
33.e: Sense of duality and Sikh

33.g: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੀਵੈ ਥੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਾ ਵਸੈ।
33.t: jiau beseevai theh kar pachhotaavai sukh naa vasai|
33.e: Inhabiting in other's lands brings repentence and takes away happiness;

33.g: ਚੜਿ ਚੜਿ ਲੜਦੇ ਭੂਮੀਏ ਧਾੜਾ ਪੇੜਾ ਖਸਣ ਖਸੈ।
33.t: chaR chaR laRadhe bhoome'ee dhaaRaa peRaa khasan khasai|
33.e: Daily the land lords quarrel, toot and extort.

33.g: ਦੁਹ ਨਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਦੂਲਹਾ ਦੁਹ ਮੁਨਸਾ ਦੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਵਿਣਸੈ।
33.t: dhuh naaree dhaa dhoolahaa dhuh munasaa dhee naar vinasai|
33.e: Husband of two women and the wife of two husbands are bound to perish;

33.g: ਹੁਇ ਉਜਾੜਾ ਖੇਤੀਐ ਦੁਹਿ ਹਾਕਮ ਦੁਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਖੁਣਸੈ।
33.t: hui ujaaRaa kheteeaai dhuh haakam dhui hukam khunasai|
33.e: Tillage under the orders of two mutually antagonist masters would go waste.

33.g: ਦੁਖ ਦੁਇ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਛਿਜੈ ਵੈਰਾਇਣੁ ਹਸੈ।
33.t: dhukh dhui chi(n)taa raat dhih ghar chhijai vairain hasai|
33.e: Where suffering and anxiety dwell day and night i.e. all the time, that house gets destroyed and the neighbourhood women laugh derisively.

33.g: ਦੁਹੁ ਖੁੰਢਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਵਸਦੀ ਵਸੈ ਨ ਨਸਦੀ ਨਸੈ।
33.t: dhuh khu(n)ddaa(n) vich rakh sir vasadhee vasai na nasadhee nasai|
33.e: If one gets one's head stuck in two cavities, one can neither stay nor run away.

33.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮੁ ਡਸੈ ॥੭॥
33.t: dhoojaa bhaau bhuia(n)gam ddasai ||7||
33.e: Likewise, the sense of duality is a virtual snake-bite.

33.g: ੮ : ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਰਪ
33.t: 8 : manmukh sarap
33.e: Manmukh and a snake

33.g: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਸਪੁ ਦੁਮੂਹਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ।
33.t: dhukheeaa dhusaT dhubaajaraa sap dhumoohaa buraa buriaaiee|
33.e: The wicked and unhappy is the betrayer who is like two headed snake which is also undesirable.

33.g: ਸਭਦੂੰ ਮੰਦੀ ਸਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਸਪਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਭਾਈ।
33.t: sabhadhoo(n) ma(n)dhee sap jon sapaa(n) vich kujaat kubhaiee|
33.e: Snake's is the worst species and out of that also the two-headed snake is a bad and wicked variety.

33.g: ਕੋੜੀ ਹੋਆ ਗੋਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਮੰਤੁ ਸੁਖਾਈ।
33.t: koRee hoaa gop gur nigure ta(n)t na ma(n)t sukhaiee|
33.e: Its master remains unknown and on this unprincipled creature no mantra works.

33.g: ਕੋੜੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੜੈ ਜਿਸ ਵਿਗੜ ਰੂਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਿ ਸਹਮਾਈ।
33.t: koRee hovai laRai jis vigaR roop hoi mar sahamaiee|
33.e: Any one whom it bites becomes leper. His face is deformed and he dies of its fear.

33.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਲਾਤੋ ਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ।
33.t: gurmukh manmukh baaharaa laato laavaa lai bujhaiee|
33.e: Manmukh, the mind-oriented one does not accept the advice of gurmukhs and creates quarrel here and there.

33.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਹੁ ਵਾਤਿ ਕੁਲਾਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਣਤੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ।
33.t: tis vih vaat kulaat man a(n)dhar ganatee taat paraiee|
33.e: His speech is poisonous and in his mind are cherished sordid plans and jealousies.

33.g: ਸਿਰ ਚਿਥੈ ਵਿਹੁ ਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੮॥
33.t: sir chithai vih baan na jaiee ||8||
33.e: His poisonous habit does not go even when his head is crushed.

33.g: ੯ : ਵੇਸ਼ਵਾ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
33.t: 9 : veshavaa dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t
33.e: Example of a prostitute

33.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਮਿਤੀ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਛਡੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਨਿਖਸਮੀ ਹੋਈ।
33.t: jiau bahu mitee vesuaa chhaddai khasam nikhasamee hoiee|
33.e: A prostitute having many lovers leaves her husband and thus becomes unclaimed masterless.

33.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਜਣੇ ਜੇ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਦਾਦਕਿ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ।
33.t: put jane je vesuaa naanak dhaadhak naau na koiee|
33.e: If she gives birth to a son, he carries no maternal or paternal name with hint

33.g: ਨਰਕਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿਆ ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਛਲਿ ਛਲੈ ਛਲੋਈ।
33.t: narak savaar seegaariaa raag ra(n)g chhal chhalai chhaloiee|
33.e: She is a decorated and ornamental hell which deceives people by loving apparent charm and grace.

33.g: ਘੰਡਾਹੇੜੁ ਅਹੇੜੀਆਂ ਮਾਣਸ ਮਿਰਗ ਵਿਣਾਹੁ ਸਥੋਈ।
33.t: gha(n)ddaaheR aheReeaa(n) maanas mirag vinaahu sathoiee|
33.e: As the hunter's pipe attractes the deer, so do the songs of a prostitute allure men to their destruction.

33.g: ਏਥੈ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਾਮ ਹੋਇ ਅਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ।
33.t: ethai marai haraam hoi agai dharageh milai na ddoiee|
33.e: Here in this world she dies an evil death and hereafter obtains no enterance into God's court.

33.g: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਜਾਣ ਰੁਪਈਆ ਮੇਖੀ ਸੋਈ।
33.t: dhukheeaa dhusaT dhubaajaraa jaan rupieeaa mekhee soiee|
33.e: Similar to her, who adheres not to one person the double-talker cunningly following two religious masters is always unhappy and like a fake rupee is exposed at the counter.

33.g: ਵਿਗੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਗਾੜੈ ਲੋਈ ॥੯॥
33.t: vigaRai aap vigaaRai loiee ||9||
33.e: Ruined himself he ruins others.

33.g: ੧੦ : ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ
33.t: 10 : dhubaajaraa
33.e: The dual-natured

33.g: ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਕਾਉ ਨ ਸੋਹਈ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗੁਤਾ।
33.t: van van kaau na sohiee kharaa siaanaa hoi vigutaa|
33.e: For crow wandering from forest to forest is no merit though it considers itself very clever.

33.g: ਚੁਤੜਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕੁਮ੍ਹਾਰਾ ਕੁਤਾ।
33.t: chutaR miTee jis lagai jaanai khasam kumhaaraa kutaa|
33.e: Dog having mud spots on the buttocks is at once recognised as a potter's pet.

33.g: ਬਾਬਾਣੀਆ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਕੁਪੁਤਾ।
33.t: baabaaneeaa kahaaneeaa ghar ghar beh beh karan kuputaa|
33.e: Unworthy sons tell everywhere about the feats of forefathers (but do nothing themselves).

33.g: ਆਗੂ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਹਾਇਦਾ ਸਾਥੁ ਛਡਿ ਚਉਰਾਹੇ ਸੁਤਾ।
33.t: aagoo hoi muhaidhaa saath chhadd chauraahe sutaa|
33.e: A leader who goes to sleep at the crossroads, gets his companions robbed (of their belongings).

33.g: ਜੰਮੀ ਸਾਖ ਉਜਾੜਦਾ ਗਲਿਆ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੀਹ ਕੁਰੁਤਾ।
33.t: ja(n)mee saakh ujaaRadhaa galiaa setee meeh kurutaa|
33.e: Unseasonal rain and hail destroy the well rooted crop.

33.g: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਖਟਰੁ ਬਲਦੁ ਜਿਵੈ ਹਲਿਜੁਤਾ।
33.t: dhukheeaa dhusaT dhubaajaraa khaTar baladh jivai halijutaa|
33.e: The suffering double talker is similar to a stubborn plaughing ox (who always gets whipped).

33.g: ਡਮਿ ਡਮਿ ਸਾਨੁ ਉਜਾੜੀ ਮੁਤਾ ॥੧੦॥
33.t: ddam ddam saan ujaaRee mutaa ||10||
33.e: Ultimately such an ox is branded and abandoned in desolate places.

33.g: ੧੧ : ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਹੈ
33.t: 11 : dhubaajaraa dhukheeaa hai
33.e: Double talker is sorrowful

33.g: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਤਾਮੇ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਕੈਹਾ ਹੋਵੈ।
33.t: dhukheeaa dhusaT dhubaajaraa taame ra(n)gahu kaihaa hovai|
33.e: The evil double-talker is copper which looks like bronze.

33.g: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਸੁ ਨ ਧੋਪੈ ਧੋਵੈ।
33.t: baahar dhisai ujalaa a(n)dhar mas na dhopai dhovai|
33.e: Apparently, the bronze looks bright but even persisting washing cannot clean its inner blackness.

33.g: ਸੰਨੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਲੁਹਾਰ ਦੀ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਮੂਹੀਂ ਕੁਸੰਗ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ।
33.t: sa(n)nee jaan luhaar dhee hoi dhumoohee(n) kusa(n)g vigovai|
33.e: The pliers of blacksmith is double mouthed but being in the bad company (of the blacksmith) it destroys itself.

33.g: ਖਿਣੁ ਤਤੀ ਆਰਣਿ ਵੜੈ ਖਿਣੁ ਠੰਢੀ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਟੋਵੈ।
33.t: khin tatee aaran vaRai khin Tha(n)ddee jal a(n)dhar Tovai|
33.e: It goes in the hot furnance and the next moment it is put in cold water.

33.g: ਤੁਮਾ ਦਿਸੇ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਮਿਤਾਲਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਵਿਲੋਵੈ।
33.t: tumaa dhise sohanaa chitramitaalaa vis vilovai|
33.e: The colocynth gives a beautiful, piebald look but inside it remains poison.

33.g: ਸਾਉ ਨ ਕਉੜਾ ਸਹਿ ਸਕੈ ਜੀਭੈ ਛਾਲੈ ਅੰਝੂ ਰੋਵੈ।
33.t: saau na kauRaa seh sakai jeebhai chhaalai a(n)jhoo rovai|
33.e: Its bitter taste cannot be tolerated; it blisters the tongue and causes tears to trickle.

33.g: ਕਲੀ ਕਨੇਰ ਨ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥੧੧॥
33.t: kalee kaner na haar parovai ||11||
33.e: No garland is prepared of the oleander buds (for their being devoid of fragrance).

33.g: ੧੨ : ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਹਾਰ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ
33.t: 12 : dhoojaa bhaau haar dhe(n)dhaa hai
33.e: Sense of duality brings defeat

33.g: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਸੁਤਰ ਮੁਰਗ ਹੋਇ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ।
33.t: dhukhee dhusaT dhubaajaraa sutar murag hoi ka(n)m na aavai|
33.e: The evil person who is double-talker is always unhappy and is useless like an ostrich.

33.g: ਉਡਣਿ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਲਦੀਐ ਪੁਰਸੁਸ ਹੋਈ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ।
33.t: auddan uddai na ladheeaai purasus hoiee aap lakhaavai|
33.e: An ostrich can neither fly nor can be laden, but it strutts ostentatiously.

33.g: ਹਸਤੀ ਦੰਦ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਦਿਖਾਲੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਖਾਵੈ।
33.t: hasatee dha(n)dh vakhaaneean hor dhikhaalai horat khaavai|
33.e: The elephant has one set of teeth for display and another for eating.

33.g: ਬਕਰੀਆਂ ਨੋ ਚਾਰ ਥਣ ਦੁਇ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਵੈ ਲਾਵੈ।
33.t: bakareeaa(n) no chaar than dhui gal vich dhui levai laavai|
33.e: Goats have four teats, two on their necks and two attached to their udders.

33.g: ਇਕਨੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਵਦਾ ਇਕ ਠਗਾਊ ਠਗ ਠਗਾਵੈ।
33.t: eikanee dhudh samaavadhaa ik Thagaauoo Thag Thagaavai|
